field.comment: Turns admin activity logging on or off.
field.modal: When Yes, actions performed by admin users are recorded to the admin activity log. Set to No to stop collecting this log.

field.comment: Whether admin login activity is recorded.
field.modal: When Yes, admin user sign-in activity is captured in the admin activity log.

field.comment: Whether admin page visits are recorded.
field.modal: When Yes, the admin pages visited by admin users are captured in the admin activity log.

field.comment: Whether admin CAPTCHA answers must match letter case.
field.modal: When **Yes**, the entered CAPTCHA text must match the case of the displayed characters. Applies only when Enable CAPTCHA in Admin is set to Yes.

field.comment: Turns the built-in image CAPTCHA on or off for Admin Panel forms.
field.modal: When **Yes**, the legacy image CAPTCHA is required on the selected admin forms; **No** disables it. Applies to the Admin Panel.

field.comment: The font used to render the admin CAPTCHA image.
field.modal: Selects which configured font the CAPTCHA characters are drawn with. Applies only when Enable CAPTCHA in Admin is set to Yes.

field.comment: Which Admin Panel forms display the CAPTCHA.
field.modal: Selects the admin forms (such as login and forgot password) that require a CAPTCHA. Applies only when Enable CAPTCHA in Admin is set to Yes.

field.comment: When the admin CAPTCHA is shown — e.g. always or after failed attempts.
field.modal: Chooses when a CAPTCHA is required, such as always or only after a number of failed login attempts. Applies only when Enable CAPTCHA in Admin is set to Yes.

field.comment: How many minutes a displayed admin CAPTCHA stays valid before expiring.
field.modal: The lifetime, in minutes, of a displayed CAPTCHA before a new one must be generated. Applies only when Enable CAPTCHA in Admin is set to Yes.

field.comment: Whether charts are displayed on the Admin dashboard.
field.modal: When **Yes**, the Admin dashboard renders its sales/order charts. Disabling can reduce load on large stores where the chart queries are heavy.

field.comment: Which store email identity sends Admin password forgot/reset emails.
field.modal: The sender identity for Admin 'forgot password' and reset emails — one of the **Store Email Addresses** identities (General Contact, Sales Representative, Customer Support, Custom 1/2).

field.comment: How long, in minutes, an admin account stays locked after too many failed logins.
field.modal: The duration, in minutes, that an admin account is locked once the failed-login limit is reached, after which sign-in is allowed again.

field.comment: Whether a periodic admin password change is forced or only recommended.
field.modal: Chooses whether admins are required to change their password once the password lifetime elapses, or merely prompted to. Governs how the password-expiry policy is applied.

field.comment: How admin password-reset requests are rate-limited — by IP, email, both, or not at all.
field.modal: Limits admin forgot-password requests by **By IP and Email**, **By IP**, **By Email**, or **None**, to throttle abuse of the password-reset flow.

field.comment: Whether Admin usernames are matched case-sensitively at login.
field.modal: When **Yes**, Admin login treats the username as case-sensitive; when **No**, case is ignored.

field.comment: Adds a secret key to Admin URLs to protect against cross-site request forgery.
field.modal: When **Yes**, Admin URLs include a per-session secret key, a CSRF protection. Leave enabled unless a specific integration requires otherwise.

field.comment: The Admin page shown first after a user signs in.
field.modal: The landing page displayed when an Admin user logs in, chosen from the available Admin menu destinations.

field.comment: Selects which installed theme is used for the Admin panel interface.
field.modal: Chooses the active Admin theme from the themes installed for the backend, changing the look of the Admin panel.

field.comment: Whether the Admin panel is served from a custom base URL.
field.modal: When **Yes**, the Admin uses a custom base URL instead of the default. Set the URL in the related field. Misconfiguration can lock you out of the Admin.

field.comment: Whether the Admin is reached at a custom path instead of the default.
field.modal: When **Yes**, the Admin is accessed under a custom path (e.g. `/myadmin`) rather than the default. Set the path in the related field. Misconfiguration can lock you out of the Admin.

field.comment: Turns AI automatic translation on or off.
field.modal: When **Yes**, the AI Integration automatic translation feature is active. Can be set per website or store view, so translation can run on some stores and not others.

field.comment: The DHL account number used for rating and shipping.
field.modal: The DHL account number sent with rate and label requests. Can be set per website.

field.comment: Turns the DHL shipping method on or off at checkout.
field.modal: When **Yes**, DHL rates are offered to shoppers during checkout; **No** hides the carrier. Can be set per website.

field.comment: The DHL REST API key used to authenticate requests.
field.modal: Key used to authenticate requests to the DHL REST API. Stored encrypted and can be set per website.

field.comment: The DHL REST API secret used to authenticate requests.
field.modal: Secret paired with the API key to authenticate requests to the DHL REST API. Stored encrypted and can be set per website.

field.comment: Whether DHL request and response data is logged for troubleshooting.
field.modal: When **Yes**, DHL API requests and responses are written to the debug log. Can be set per website.

field.comment: The parcel depth sent to DHL for rating.
field.modal: The package depth used for DHL quotes. Applies only when **Size** is set to the regular/custom size. Can differ per store view.

field.comment: Which DHL document (paperwork) shipping services are offered.
field.modal: Selects the DHL services available for document shipments. Can be set per website.

field.comment: The DHL service used for free shipping on document shipments.
field.modal: The DHL document service applied when an order qualifies for free shipping. Applies when the content type is Documents. Can be set per website.

field.comment: The DHL service used for free shipping on non-document shipments.
field.modal: The DHL parcel service applied when an order qualifies for free shipping. Applies when the content type is Non Documents. Can be set per website.

field.comment: Enables free DHL shipping once the order subtotal reaches a threshold.
field.modal: When enabled, DHL shipping is free for orders whose subtotal meets the Free Shipping Amount Threshold. Can be set per website.

field.comment: The order subtotal at which DHL shipping becomes free.
field.modal: Minimum order subtotal that qualifies for free DHL shipping. Applies only when Enable Free Shipping Threshold is enabled. Can be set per website.

field.comment: The handling fee added to DHL shipping charges.
field.modal: The amount or percentage added to each DHL quote, depending on how Calculate Handling Fee is set. Can be set per website.

field.comment: Whether the DHL handling fee is a fixed amount or a percentage.
field.modal: Sets how the handling fee is calculated — as a fixed amount or as a percentage of the shipping cost. Can be set per website.

field.comment: The parcel height sent to DHL for rating.
field.modal: The package height used for DHL quotes. Applies only when **Size** is set to the regular/custom size. Can differ per store view.

field.comment: The DHL Access ID used to authenticate API requests.
field.modal: Credential issued by DHL to authenticate rate and label requests. Stored encrypted and can be set per website.

field.comment: Which DHL non-document (parcel) shipping services are offered.
field.modal: Selects the DHL services available for non-document (parcel) shipments. Can be set per website.

field.comment: The DHL API password used to authenticate requests.
field.modal: Password paired with the DHL Access ID to authenticate API requests. Stored encrypted and can be set per website.

field.comment: Whether DHL is offered to all allowed countries or only specific ones.
field.modal: Chooses between offering DHL to all allowed countries or to the specific list set in Ship to Specific Countries. Can be set per website.

field.comment: Whether DHL requests use the test (sandbox) environment instead of production.
field.modal: When **Yes**, DHL API calls use the sandbox/test endpoint for safe testing; **No** uses production. Can be set per website.

field.comment: Whether to still show DHL at checkout when it returns no rates.
field.modal: When **Yes**, DHL is shown with its error message even if no rates apply; **No** hides it. Can be set per website.

field.comment: Selects a regular or custom parcel size for DHL shipments.
field.modal: Chooses the parcel size sent to DHL; selecting the regular/custom option enables the Height, Depth and Width fields. Can be set per store view.

field.comment: The position of DHL in the list of shipping methods at checkout.
field.modal: Controls where DHL appears relative to other carriers; lower numbers sort first. Can be set per website.

field.comment: The countries DHL is offered to when limited to specific countries.
field.modal: The destination countries where DHL is available, used when Ship to Applicable Countries is set to specific countries. Can be set per website.

field.comment: The message shown to shoppers when DHL rates can't be retrieved.
field.modal: Text displayed at checkout when DHL returns no rates or an error. Can differ per store view.

field.comment: The carrier name shown to shoppers for DHL at checkout.
field.modal: The label displayed for this shipping method in the cart and checkout. Can differ per store view.

field.comment: Selects which DHL web-service API is used to request rates and labels.
field.modal: Chooses the DHL integration used for quoting and shipping — the **DHL XML** or **DHL REST** API. Can be set per website.

field.comment: The weight unit used for package weights sent to DHL.
field.modal: The unit of measure applied when sending package weights to DHL. Can differ per store view.

field.comment: The parcel width sent to DHL for rating.
field.modal: The package width used for DHL quotes. Applies only when **Size** is set to the regular/custom size. Can differ per store view.

field.comment: Whether FedEx shipping rates are offered to customers at checkout.
field.modal: When **Yes**, FedEx shipping methods are available as options during checkout. Can be set per website.

field.comment: Which FedEx shipping methods are offered to customers.
field.modal: Selects which FedEx shipping services are offered as options at checkout. Can be set per website.

field.comment: The FedEx API key used to authenticate rate and shipping requests.
field.modal: The API key from your FedEx developer account, used to authenticate requests to the FedEx web services. Stored encrypted. Can be set per website.

field.comment: Whether FedEx request and response data is logged for debugging.
field.modal: When **Yes**, FedEx API requests and responses are written to the debug log for troubleshooting. Can be set per website.

field.comment: Whether a separate set of credentials is used for the FedEx tracking API.
field.modal: When **Yes**, a separate set of FedEx tracking API credentials is used for shipment tracking requests, enabling the Tracking API Key and Secret fields. Can be set per website.

field.comment: The FedEx method used when an order qualifies for free shipping.
field.modal: Selects which FedEx shipping method is used when an order qualifies for free shipping. Can be set per website.

field.comment: Whether free shipping is offered once an order subtotal threshold is met.
field.modal: Set to **Enable** to offer FedEx free shipping for orders whose subtotal reaches the configured threshold. Can be set per website.

field.comment: The order subtotal required to qualify for free FedEx shipping.
field.modal: The minimum order subtotal at which FedEx free shipping becomes available. Applies only when **Enable Free Shipping Threshold** is enabled. Can be set per website.

field.comment: Whether the handling fee is applied per order or per package.
field.modal: Chooses whether the handling fee is applied once per order or to each package. Can be set per website.

field.comment: The handling fee amount or percentage added to FedEx rates.
field.modal: The handling fee value added to FedEx shipping rates, interpreted as a fixed amount or percentage per the Calculate Handling Fee setting. Can be set per website.

field.comment: Whether the handling fee is a fixed amount or a percentage.
field.modal: Chooses whether the handling fee added to FedEx rates is calculated as a fixed amount or as a percentage. Can be set per website.

field.comment: The maximum weight allowed for a single FedEx package.
field.modal: The maximum weight of a single package for FedEx shipments; heavier orders are split across packages. Consult FedEx for the maximum supported weight. Can be set per website.

field.comment: The default FedEx packaging type assumed for rate requests.
field.modal: Selects the FedEx packaging type assumed when requesting shipping rates. Can be set per website.

field.comment: The FedEx pickup method used when requesting rates.
field.modal: Selects the FedEx pickup type, i.e. how packages are handed to FedEx, used when requesting shipping rates. Can be set per website.

field.comment: The FedEx production web-services endpoint URL.
field.modal: The endpoint URL for the FedEx production web services. Applies only when **Sandbox Mode** is set to No. Can be set per website.

field.comment: Whether shipments are rated as residential deliveries.
field.modal: When **Yes**, FedEx rates are requested for residential delivery, which may change the price. Can be set per website.

field.comment: Whether FedEx ships to all allowed countries or only selected ones.
field.modal: Chooses whether FedEx shipping is offered to all allowed countries or only to a specific list set in Ship to Specific Countries. Can be set per website.

field.comment: Whether requests use the FedEx sandbox (test) environment instead of production.
field.modal: When **Yes**, FedEx requests are sent to the sandbox (test) environment rather than production. Can be set per website.

field.comment: The FedEx sandbox (test) web-services endpoint URL.
field.modal: The endpoint URL for the FedEx sandbox (test) web services. Applies only when **Sandbox Mode** is set to Yes. Can be set per website.

field.comment: The FedEx API secret key used with the API key to authenticate requests.
field.modal: The API secret associated with your FedEx API key, used to authenticate requests to the FedEx web services. Stored encrypted. Can be set per website.

field.comment: Whether rates are requested per package or for all packages together.
field.modal: Chooses how package data is sent to FedEx when requesting rates — divided into separate packages or as a single combined request. Can be set per website.

field.comment: Whether the FedEx method is still shown when it is not available for an order.
field.modal: When **Yes**, the FedEx shipping method is displayed at checkout even when it is not applicable, shown with the error message. Can be set per website.

field.comment: The position of FedEx among shipping methods at checkout.
field.modal: A numeric value controlling where FedEx appears relative to other carriers in the checkout list; lower values appear first. Can be set per website.

field.comment: The specific countries FedEx shipping is offered to.
field.modal: Selects the countries to which FedEx shipping is offered when Ship to Applicable Countries is limited to specific countries. Can be set per website.

field.comment: The message shown to customers when FedEx rates cannot be retrieved.
field.modal: The error message displayed at checkout when FedEx shipping rates are unavailable. Can be set per website or store view.

field.comment: The carrier name shown to customers for FedEx shipping at checkout.
field.modal: The label displayed to customers for the FedEx carrier group at checkout. Can be set per website or store view.

field.comment: The FedEx API key used for shipment tracking requests.
field.modal: The API key used to authenticate FedEx shipment tracking requests. Applies only when **Enable Tracking API credentials** is set to Yes. Stored encrypted.

field.comment: The FedEx API secret used for shipment tracking requests.
field.modal: The API secret used with the tracking API key to authenticate FedEx tracking requests. Applies only when **Enable Tracking API credentials** is Yes. Stored encrypted.

field.comment: The weight unit used for package weights sent to FedEx.
field.modal: Selects the weight unit used for package weights in FedEx rate requests. Can be set per website.

field.comment: Turns the Flat Rate shipping method on or off at checkout.
field.modal: When set to **Yes**, the Flat Rate carrier is offered at checkout. Can be set per website.

field.comment: The handling fee added to the Flat Rate shipping charge.
field.modal: The handling fee amount added to Flat Rate shipping, applied according to **Calculate Handling Fee**. Can be set per website.

field.comment: How the Flat Rate handling fee is calculated.
field.modal: Sets the basis for the handling fee added to Flat Rate shipping — for example a fixed amount or a proportion of the rate. Works together with **Handling Fee**. Can be set per website.

field.comment: The Flat Rate method name shown to customers at checkout.
field.modal: The label shown next to the Flat Rate price in the list of shipping methods at checkout. Can differ per store view.

field.comment: The flat shipping amount charged by the Flat Rate method.
field.modal: The fixed shipping charge applied by the Flat Rate carrier. Can be set per website.

field.comment: Whether Flat Rate is offered to all countries or only selected ones.
field.modal: Chooses whether Flat Rate is available for all allowed countries or only for the countries chosen in **Ship to Specific Countries**. Can be set per website.

field.comment: Whether Flat Rate still appears at checkout when it is not available for the order.
field.modal: When **Yes**, the Flat Rate method is still listed (shown as unavailable) when it does not apply to the order, rather than being hidden. Can be set per website.

field.comment: The position of Flat Rate among the shipping methods at checkout.
field.modal: A sort-order number controlling where Flat Rate appears relative to other carriers in the checkout shipping list. Can be set per website.

field.comment: The countries Flat Rate is offered to when limited to specific countries.
field.modal: The set of destination countries for which Flat Rate is available. Applies when **Ship to Applicable Countries** is set to specific countries. Can be set per website.

field.comment: The message shown when Flat Rate shipping is unavailable for the order.
field.modal: The error text displayed to customers when Flat Rate cannot be offered for their order. Can differ per store view.

field.comment: The heading shown for the Flat Rate carrier at checkout.
field.modal: The carrier title displayed above the Flat Rate method at checkout. Can differ per store view.

field.comment: The basis on which the flat rate is charged.
field.modal: Determines what the flat rate applies to — for example once per order or per item in the order. Can be set per website.

field.comment: Turns the Free Shipping method on or off at checkout.
field.modal: When set to **Yes**, the Free Shipping carrier is offered at checkout for qualifying orders. Can be set per website.

field.comment: The order subtotal a customer must reach to qualify for free shipping.
field.modal: The minimum order amount that makes an order eligible for Free Shipping. Can be set per website.

field.comment: The Free Shipping method name shown to customers at checkout.
field.modal: The label shown next to the Free Shipping option in the list of shipping methods at checkout. Can differ per store view.

field.comment: Whether Free Shipping is offered to all countries or only selected ones.
field.modal: Chooses whether Free Shipping is available for all allowed countries or only for the countries chosen in **Ship to Specific Countries**. Can be set per website.

field.comment: Whether Free Shipping still appears at checkout when it is not available for the order.
field.modal: When **Yes**, the Free Shipping method is still listed (shown as unavailable) when it does not apply to the order, rather than being hidden. Can be set per website.

field.comment: The position of Free Shipping among the shipping methods at checkout.
field.modal: A sort-order number controlling where Free Shipping appears relative to other carriers in the checkout shipping list. Can be set per website.

field.comment: The countries Free Shipping is offered to when limited to specific countries.
field.modal: The set of destination countries for which Free Shipping is available. Applies when **Ship to Applicable Countries** is set to specific countries. Can be set per website.

field.comment: The message shown when Free Shipping is unavailable for the order.
field.modal: The error text displayed to customers when Free Shipping cannot be offered for their order. Can differ per store view.

field.comment: Whether the minimum order amount is compared against the subtotal including tax.
field.modal: When **Yes**, the **Minimum Order Amount** is checked against the subtotal with tax included rather than excluded. Can be set per website.

field.comment: The heading shown for the Free Shipping carrier at checkout.
field.modal: The carrier title displayed above the Free Shipping method at checkout. Can differ per store view.

field.comment: Whether the In-Store Delivery (in-store pickup) shipping method is offered at checkout.
field.modal: When Yes, the In-Store Delivery method is available as a delivery option during checkout. Can differ per website.

field.comment: The method name shown to shoppers for the In-Store Delivery option.
field.modal: The label shown for this specific In-Store Delivery method in the checkout shipping options. Can differ per website or store view.

field.comment: The price charged for the In-Store Delivery method.
field.modal: The amount charged to the shopper when they choose In-Store Delivery. Can differ per website.

field.comment: The message shown when the In-Store Delivery method is unavailable.
field.modal: The error text displayed to shoppers when In-Store Delivery cannot be offered for their cart. Can differ per website or store view.

field.comment: The title shown to shoppers for the In-Store Delivery carrier.
field.modal: The heading shown for the In-Store Delivery carrier above its method at checkout. Can differ per website or store view.

field.comment: Turns the Table Rates shipping method on or off at checkout.
field.modal: When set to **Yes**, the Table Rates carrier is offered at checkout, using the imported rate table. Can be set per website.

field.comment: The order condition the rate table is looked up by.
field.modal: Selects which order measure the Table Rates lookup is based on, such as weight, price, or item count. The imported rate table must match the condition chosen here. Can be set per website.

field.comment: Downloads the current table rate data as a CSV file.
field.modal: Exports this website's Table Rates to a CSV file for editing or backup. Operates at website scope.

field.comment: The handling fee added to the Table Rates shipping charge.
field.modal: The handling fee amount added to Table Rate shipping, applied according to **Calculate Handling Fee**. Can be set per website.

field.comment: How the Table Rates handling fee is calculated.
field.modal: Sets the basis for the handling fee added to Table Rate shipping — for example a fixed amount or a proportion of the rate. Works together with **Handling Fee**. Can be set per website.

field.comment: Uploads a CSV file of table rates for this website.
field.modal: Imports a CSV file defining the Table Rates for this website, replacing the existing rate table. Operates at website scope.

field.comment: Whether virtual products count toward the value used to look up table rates.
field.modal: When **Yes**, virtual products are included in the order value used for the Table Rates lookup. Can be set per website.

field.comment: The Table Rates method name shown to customers at checkout.
field.modal: The label shown next to the Table Rates price in the list of shipping methods at checkout. Can differ per store view.

field.comment: Whether Table Rates is offered to all countries or only selected ones.
field.modal: Chooses whether Table Rates is available for all allowed countries or only for the countries chosen in **Ship to Specific Countries**. Can be set per website.

field.comment: Whether Table Rates still appears at checkout when it is not available for the order.
field.modal: When **Yes**, the Table Rates method is still listed (shown as unavailable) when it does not apply to the order, rather than being hidden. Can be set per website.

field.comment: The position of Table Rates among the shipping methods at checkout.
field.modal: A sort-order number controlling where Table Rates appears relative to other carriers in the checkout shipping list. Can be set per website.

field.comment: The countries Table Rates is offered to when limited to specific countries.
field.modal: The set of destination countries for which Table Rates is available. Applies when **Ship to Applicable Countries** is set to specific countries. Can be set per website.

field.comment: The message shown when Table Rates shipping is unavailable for the order.
field.modal: The error text displayed to customers when Table Rates cannot be offered for their order. Can differ per store view.

field.comment: The heading shown for the Table Rates carrier at checkout.
field.modal: The carrier title displayed above the Table Rates method at checkout. Can differ per store view.

field.comment: The UPS Access License Number used to authenticate rate and label requests to UPS.
field.modal: The UPS-issued Access License Number that authorises this store's calls to the UPS API. Stored encrypted. Can be set per website, so separate UPS accounts can serve different websites.

field.comment: Enables UPS as a shipping method offered at checkout.
field.modal: When set to **Yes**, UPS rates are offered to customers at checkout. Set to **No** to hide UPS. Can be enabled per website.

field.comment: The UPS service levels offered to customers at checkout.
field.modal: Selects which UPS shipping services (service levels) are presented to customers. Only the methods chosen here are quoted. Can differ per website.

field.comment: The UPS packaging type used when requesting rates.
field.modal: The UPS container/packaging type assumed when quoting rates. Pick the packaging that matches how you ship. Can differ per website.

field.comment: Whether to log UPS request and response data for troubleshooting.
field.modal: When **Yes**, UPS API requests and responses are written to the debug log to help diagnose rating issues. Can differ per website.

field.comment: The destination type UPS uses when calculating rates.
field.modal: Selects the kind of delivery destination UPS assumes when quoting rates, which can change the returned prices. Can differ per website.

field.comment: The UPS service level used for the free shipping option.
field.modal: The UPS service applied when an order qualifies for free shipping. Can differ per website.

field.comment: Enables a free-shipping threshold for UPS based on order subtotal.
field.modal: When enabled, orders at or above the configured subtotal qualify for free UPS shipping. Can differ per website.

field.comment: The order subtotal at which UPS shipping becomes free.
field.modal: The minimum order subtotal that qualifies for free UPS shipping. Applies only when **Enable Free Shipping Threshold** is enabled. Can differ per website.

field.comment: The URL of the UPS REST API endpoint.
field.modal: The endpoint URL used when UPS requests go through the REST API. Change only if directed by UPS. Can differ per website.

field.comment: The UPS gateway URL used for rate requests.
field.modal: The endpoint URL this store calls to request UPS rates. Change only if directed by UPS. Can differ per website.

field.comment: The URL of the UPS XML rate API endpoint.
field.modal: The endpoint URL used when UPS requests go through the legacy XML API. Change only if directed by UPS. Can differ per website.

field.comment: Whether the handling fee is applied per order or per package.
field.modal: Chooses whether the UPS handling fee is charged once per order or for each package. Can differ per website.

field.comment: The handling fee added to UPS shipping rates.
field.modal: The handling amount added to quoted UPS rates, interpreted as a fixed value or percentage per the **Calculate Handling Fee** setting. Can differ per website.

field.comment: Whether the handling fee is a fixed amount or a percentage.
field.modal: Chooses whether the UPS handling fee is applied as a fixed amount or as a percentage of the shipping rate. Can differ per website.

field.comment: Whether the UPS account runs against the live production API rather than a test environment.
field.modal: When **Yes**, requests go to the live UPS production environment; **No** targets the test environment. Can differ per website.

field.comment: The maximum package weight UPS will quote.
field.modal: The heaviest single package UPS will rate; consult UPS for the supported maximum. Orders above this may be split or return no rate. Can differ per website.

field.comment: The minimum package weight UPS will quote.
field.modal: The lightest single package UPS will rate; consult UPS for the supported minimum. Can differ per website.

field.comment: Whether to request UPS negotiated (account-specific) rates instead of published rates.
field.modal: When **Yes**, UPS returns the negotiated rates tied to your account rather than standard published rates. Requires a UPS account that is enabled for negotiated rates. Can differ per website.

field.comment: The UPS origin region that determines which shipping methods are available.
field.modal: The region the shipment originates from, which governs the set of UPS services that can be offered. Can differ per website.

field.comment: The password for the UPS account used to authenticate API requests.
field.modal: The password paired with the UPS user ID to authenticate API calls. Stored encrypted. Can be set per website.

field.comment: How packages are handed to UPS, which affects the rates returned.
field.modal: The pickup method describing how packages reach UPS (for example scheduled pickup or drop-off). The choice can change the rates UPS quotes. Can differ per website.

field.comment: Whether UPS is offered to all countries or only to selected ones.
field.modal: Chooses between offering UPS to all allowed countries or restricting it to the countries chosen in **Ship to Specific Countries**. Can differ per website.

field.comment: How package weights are packaged into UPS rate requests.
field.modal: Chooses how the cart's weight is sent to UPS when requesting rates — as a single combined request or split across packages. Affects how multi-item orders are quoted. Can differ per website.

field.comment: Whether to still show UPS at checkout when it returns no applicable rates.
field.modal: When **Yes**, UPS remains visible at checkout even when no rate is available, showing the configured error message instead of hiding the method. Can differ per website.

field.comment: The position of UPS relative to other shipping methods at checkout.
field.modal: Controls where UPS appears in the list of shipping methods; lower numbers sort higher. Can differ per website.

field.comment: The countries UPS can ship to when limited to specific countries.
field.modal: The set of destination countries for which UPS is offered. Applies when **Ship to Applicable Countries** is set to specific countries. Can differ per website.

field.comment: The message shown to customers when UPS returns no available rates.
field.modal: The text displayed at checkout when UPS cannot provide a rate. Can be set per store view for localised messaging.

field.comment: The carrier name shown to customers at checkout for UPS.
field.modal: The heading customers see above the UPS shipping options at checkout. Can be set per store view, so each store can show a localised name.

field.comment: The URL of the UPS tracking REST endpoint.
field.modal: The endpoint URL used to retrieve UPS tracking information via the REST API. Change only if directed by UPS. Can differ per website.

field.comment: The URL of the UPS tracking XML endpoint.
field.modal: The endpoint URL used to retrieve UPS tracking information via the XML API. Change only if directed by UPS. Can differ per website.

field.comment: The UPS integration/account type used for rate requests.
field.modal: Selects which UPS integration this store uses when authenticating and requesting rates. Match it to the account type UPS provisioned. Can differ per website.

field.comment: The weight unit used in UPS rate requests.
field.modal: The unit of weight sent to UPS when quoting rates. Set it to match how product weights are recorded in your catalog. Can differ per website.

field.comment: The UPS user ID used to authenticate API requests.
field.modal: The UPS account user ID, paired with the password, used to authenticate API calls. Stored encrypted. Can be set per website.

field.comment: The USPS account number used with the REST API.
field.modal: The USPS account number associated with your REST API credentials. Applies only when **USPS Type** is REST. Can differ per store view.

field.comment: The kind of USPS account used for REST pricing.
field.modal: Selects the type of USPS account used with the REST API, which affects the pricing available. Applies only when **USPS Type** is REST.

field.comment: Turns the USPS shipping method on or off at checkout.
field.modal: Controls whether USPS shipping rates are offered to customers during checkout. Can be set per website.

field.comment: Which USPS (XML Web Tools) shipping methods are offered to customers at checkout.
field.modal: Selects which USPS services returned by the XML Web Tools API are offered to shoppers at checkout; unselected services are hidden. Applies only when **USPS Type** is the XML Web Tools. Can be set per website.

field.comment: The consumer key (client ID) for the USPS REST API account.
field.modal: The OAuth consumer key issued by USPS for the REST API, used to obtain access tokens. Stored encrypted. Applies only when **USPS Type** is REST.

field.comment: The consumer secret (client secret) for the USPS REST API account.
field.modal: The OAuth consumer secret paired with the USPS REST consumer key. Stored encrypted; keep it confidential. Applies only when **USPS Type** is REST.

field.comment: The USPS package/container type reported when requesting XML rates.
field.modal: The packaging/container type reported to USPS when requesting rates, which affects eligible services and prices. Applies only when **USPS Type** is the XML Web Tools. Can be set per website.

field.comment: The USPS Customer Registration ID (CRID) tied to your account.
field.modal: Your USPS Customer Registration ID (CRID), identifying your business to USPS. Applies only when **USPS Type** is REST.

field.comment: Whether USPS request and response details are logged for troubleshooting.
field.modal: When **Yes**, USPS API requests and responses are written to the debug log to help diagnose rating problems. Can be set per website.

field.comment: Which USPS method is used for orders that qualify for free shipping.
field.modal: The USPS service used to fulfil orders that qualify for free shipping. Can be set per website.

field.comment: Whether reaching a minimum order subtotal unlocks free USPS shipping.
field.modal: Enables or disables a free-shipping threshold for USPS: when set to **Enable**, orders reaching the subtotal set below ship free. Can be set per website.

field.comment: The order subtotal at which USPS shipping becomes free.
field.modal: The minimum order subtotal that qualifies for free USPS shipping. Applies only when the free-shipping threshold is enabled. Can be set per website.

field.comment: The USPS REST API test endpoint URL used when not in production mode.
field.modal: The USPS REST API endpoint used for rate requests in development/test mode. Applies only when **USPS Type** is REST and **Mode** is set to development. Can be set per website.

field.comment: The USPS REST API production endpoint URL used for live rate requests.
field.modal: The USPS REST API endpoint used for rate requests in production. Applies only when **USPS Type** is REST and **Mode** is set to live/production. Can be set per website.

field.comment: The secure (HTTPS) USPS Web Tools endpoint used for requests that require it.
field.modal: The secure USPS Web Tools (XML) gateway URL, used for requests that require HTTPS. Applies only when **USPS Type** is the XML Web Tools. Can be set per website.

field.comment: The USPS Web Tools (XML) endpoint URL rate requests are sent to.
field.modal: The base URL of the USPS Web Tools (XML) gateway used for rate requests. Applies only when **USPS Type** is the XML Web Tools. Change only if USPS provides a different endpoint. Can be set per website.

field.comment: The package girth used for USPS rating when the size is Large.
field.modal: The package girth (the distance around the package) sent to USPS for rate calculation. Applies only when **Size** is set to Large. Can be set per website.

field.comment: Whether the handling fee is applied once per order or to each package.
field.modal: Determines whether the handling fee is charged **per order** or **per package**. Can be set per website.

field.comment: The handling fee amount or percentage added to USPS rates.
field.modal: The handling fee value added to the USPS rate, interpreted as a fixed amount or a percentage according to **Calculate Handling Fee**. Can be set per website.

field.comment: Whether the handling fee is a fixed amount or a percentage of the rate.
field.modal: Chooses how the handling fee is calculated — as a **fixed** amount or a **percentage** of the shipping rate. Can be set per website.

field.comment: The package height used for USPS rating when the size is Large.
field.modal: The package height sent to USPS for rate calculation. Applies only when **Size** is set to Large. Can be set per website.

field.comment: The package length used for USPS rating when the size is Large.
field.modal: The package length sent to USPS for rate calculation. Applies only when **Size** is set to Large. Can be set per website.

field.comment: Whether packages are machinable (handled by USPS sorting machines), which affects rates.
field.modal: Declares whether shipments are machinable — able to be processed by USPS automated sorting equipment — which influences the rates returned. Applies only when **USPS Type** is the XML Web Tools. Can be set per website.

field.comment: The maximum weight per package before an order is split into multiple packages.
field.modal: The heaviest a single package may be; orders over this weight are divided into multiple packages for rating. Consult USPS for the maximum supported weight. Can be set per website.

field.comment: The USPS Mailer Identifier (MID) associated with your account.
field.modal: Your USPS Mailer Identifier (MID), used to identify the mailer on shipments. Applies only when **USPS Type** is REST.

field.comment: The Mailer Identifier (MID) used on USPS manifests.
field.modal: The Manifest MID used when generating USPS manifests. Applies only when **USPS Type** is REST.

field.comment: Whether the carrier connects to the USPS production or test environment.
field.modal: Switches the carrier between the USPS live/production environment and the development/test environment, which determines which gateway URL is used. Can be set per website.

field.comment: The password for the USPS Web Tools (XML) account.
field.modal: The password paired with the USPS Web Tools (XML) user ID. Stored encrypted. Applies only when **USPS Type** is the XML Web Tools.

field.comment: Which USPS pricing option is requested for rates.
field.modal: Selects the pricing option USPS returns for rate requests (for example retail versus commercial pricing). Applies only when **USPS Type** is REST.

field.comment: Which USPS (REST API) shipping methods are offered to customers at checkout.
field.modal: Selects which USPS services returned by the REST API are offered to shoppers at checkout; unselected services are hidden. Applies only when **USPS Type** is REST. Can be set per website.

field.comment: Whether USPS is offered to all allowed countries or only selected ones.
field.modal: Chooses whether USPS shipping is available for **all allowed countries** or only the **specific countries** selected below. Can be set per website.

field.comment: How items are grouped into packages when USPS rates are requested.
field.modal: Controls how items are grouped into packages for rate requests (for example a single combined request versus per-package requests). Can be set per website.

field.comment: Whether USPS is still listed at checkout when it returns no rates.
field.modal: When **Yes**, the USPS carrier is shown at checkout even when it returns no applicable rates, typically with the error message. Can be set per website.

field.comment: The package size category sent to USPS; selecting Large reveals dimension fields.
field.modal: The USPS package size category. Choosing the **Large** size requires the width, length, height and girth values below. Can be set per website.

field.comment: The position of USPS relative to other carriers in the checkout list.
field.modal: A numeric value controlling where USPS appears among shipping carriers at checkout; lower values sort higher. Can be set per website.

field.comment: The countries USPS shipping is offered to when limited to specific countries.
field.modal: The list of destination countries that may use USPS shipping, applied when **Ship to Applicable Countries** is set to specific countries. Can be set per website.

field.comment: The message shown to customers when USPS rates can't be retrieved.
field.modal: The text shown to shoppers at checkout when the USPS carrier cannot return a rate. Can differ per store view.

field.comment: The carrier name shown to customers next to USPS shipping options at checkout.
field.modal: The label displayed to shoppers for this carrier's shipping methods at checkout. Can differ per store view, so each storefront can show its own wording.

field.comment: The USPS Web Tools (XML) account user ID used to authenticate rate requests.
field.modal: The user ID issued by USPS for the Web Tools (XML) API, used to authenticate requests. Stored encrypted. Applies only when **USPS Type** is the XML Web Tools.

field.comment: Which USPS API integration to use — the legacy XML Web Tools or the newer REST API.
field.modal: Selects the USPS API the carrier connects through: the legacy **USPS Web Tools (XML)** or the newer **USPS REST** API. The choice determines which credential and gateway fields below apply. Can be set per website.

field.comment: The package width used for USPS rating when the size is Large.
field.modal: The package width sent to USPS for rate calculation. Applies only when **Size** is set to Large. Can be set per website.

field.comment: The order in which the day, month and year inputs appear for date custom options.
field.modal: Sets the arrangement of the day, month and year fields for date-type custom options, to match local date conventions.

field.comment: Whether time custom options use a 12-hour or 24-hour clock.
field.modal: Chooses between a **12h (AM/PM)** and a **24h** time format for time-type custom options.

field.comment: Whether date-type custom options use a JavaScript date picker.
field.modal: When **Yes**, date and time custom options are entered through a JavaScript calendar instead of separate dropdowns.

field.comment: Whether downloads are delivered inline or as a file attachment.
field.modal: Sets the HTTP Content-Disposition for downloads, choosing whether files are served **inline** (shown in the browser) or as an **attachment** (prompting a save). Can differ per website or store view.

field.comment: The default limit on how many times a downloadable link can be downloaded.
field.modal: The default maximum number of downloads allowed per link for new downloadable products. Individual products can override this. Can be set per website.

field.comment: Whether download links open in a new browser window.
field.modal: When **Yes**, downloadable links open in a new browser window or tab instead of the current one. Can be set per website.

field.comment: The default heading shown above a downloadable product's links.
field.modal: The default title for the downloadable links section on product pages. Can differ per website or store view.

field.comment: The order item status at which a customer's downloads become available.
field.modal: Determines when purchased downloads are released to the customer, based on the order item's status (such as Pending or Invoiced). Can be set per website.

field.comment: The default heading shown above a downloadable product's samples.
field.modal: The default title for the samples section on downloadable product pages. Can differ per website or store view.

field.comment: Whether downloadable links can be shared rather than tied to the purchasing account.
field.modal: When **Yes**, download links are shareable and can be accessed without signing in to the purchasing account; when **No**, access is restricted to that account. Can be set per website.

field.comment: Whether the storefront reads categories from flat (denormalized) tables.
field.modal: When **Yes**, category data is served from a flat table for faster reads. A legacy performance option; leave off unless a specific setup requires it.

field.comment: Whether the storefront reads products from flat (denormalized) tables.
field.modal: When **Yes**, product data is served from a flat table for faster reads. A legacy performance option; leave off unless a specific setup requires it.

field.comment: The default layout of product lists — grid, list, or a toggle between them.
field.modal: How category product lists are displayed by default: **Grid Only**, **List Only**, **Grid (default) / List**, or **List (default) / Grid** (the latter two let shoppers switch).

field.comment: Whether a tooltip preview is shown when hovering over a swatch.
field.modal: When **Yes**, hovering over a swatch displays a tooltip preview of the option. Can differ per website or store view.

field.comment: Whether swatches appear in product listings.
field.modal: When **Yes**, attribute swatches are shown for products in category and search listings; when **No**, they are hidden there. Can differ per website or store view.

field.comment: How many swatches are shown per product in product listings.
field.modal: The maximum number of swatches displayed for a single product in category and search listings. Can differ per website or store view.

field.comment: Whether the category filter is shown in layered navigation.
field.modal: When **Yes**, layered navigation includes a category filter alongside attribute filters.

field.comment: Whether the number of matching products is shown next to each filter option.
field.modal: When **Yes**, layered navigation shows a count of matching products beside each filter value. Can be set per store view.

field.comment: How price filter ranges are calculated — automatically or by a manual step.
field.modal: Chooses how price-filter buckets are built: automatically, or using a manual fixed step set in Default Price Navigation Step. Can be set per store view.

field.comment: The fixed price interval used to build price-filter ranges.
field.modal: The price interval for each price-filter range. Applies only when Price Navigation Step Calculation is set to Manual. Can be set per store view.

field.comment: How many category levels deep the top navigation menu renders.
field.modal: The maximum category depth shown in the storefront top menu. A smaller value keeps the menu shallow on deep category trees.

field.comment: The fallback images shown for products that have no image of their own.
field.modal: Upload the placeholder images (base, small and thumbnail) used wherever a product is missing its own image.

field.comment: Whether a product's base video plays automatically on the product page.
field.modal: When **Yes**, the video marked as the product's base media starts playing automatically on the product page. Can be set per website or store view.

field.comment: Whether related videos are shown when a product video ends.
field.modal: When **Yes**, related videos are displayed after a product video finishes playing. Can be set per website or store view.

field.comment: Whether a product video restarts automatically after it finishes.
field.modal: When **Yes**, a product video loops, restarting automatically once it reaches the end. Can be set per website or store view.

field.comment: The YouTube Data API key used to fetch video details when adding product videos.
field.modal: The API key the admin uses to call the YouTube Data API when retrieving metadata for product videos hosted on YouTube. Obtain it from the Google API console.

field.comment: Whether customers can sign up to be emailed when a product's price changes.
field.modal: When **Yes**, a price-change alert sign-up appears on product pages so customers can be emailed when the price changes; **No** removes it. Can be set per website or store view.

field.comment: Whether customers can sign up to be emailed when an out-of-stock product is available again.
field.modal: When **Yes**, an in-stock alert sign-up appears on product pages so customers can be notified when the item returns to stock; **No** removes it. Can differ per website.

field.comment: The email address notified if the product alert cron job fails.
field.modal: The recipient address for error notifications raised when the product-alert cron job cannot complete. Leave empty to send no error email.

field.comment: Which store email identity product alert error emails are sent from.
field.modal: Selects the sender identity for product-alert error notifications — one of the **Store Email Addresses** identities configured under *General → Store Email Addresses*.

field.comment: How often the scheduled job that sends product alert emails runs.
field.modal: Sets the schedule for the product-alert cron job that sends pending price and stock notifications. Choose from the available frequency options.

field.comment: The time of day the product alert cron job runs.
field.modal: The start time (hour, minute, second) at which the product-alert cron job runs on its configured frequency.

field.comment: Which store email identity product alert emails are sent from.
field.modal: Selects the sender identity used for product alert emails — one of the **Store Email Addresses** identities (General Contact, Sales Representative, Customer Support, Custom 1/2) configured under *General → Store Email Addresses*. Can differ per store view.

field.comment: The number of products shown in the Recently Compared block.
field.modal: The maximum number of items displayed in the Recently Compared Products block. Can differ per store view.

field.comment: How long a product stays in the Recently Compared widget, in days.
field.modal: The retention period, in days, for entries shown by the Recently Compared Products widget.

field.comment: How long a product stays in the Recently Viewed widget, in days.
field.modal: The retention period, in days, for entries shown by the Recently Viewed Products widget.

field.comment: The scope recently viewed/compared product lists are tracked across.
field.modal: Sets whether recently viewed and compared products are tracked per **Website**, **Store**, or **Store View**. Can be set per website.

field.comment: Whether recently viewed/compared products are stored server-side rather than only in the browser.
field.modal: When **Yes**, the recently viewed/compared lists are synchronised to backend storage, so they follow a signed-in customer across devices instead of living only in the browser.

field.comment: The number of products shown in the Recently Viewed block.
field.modal: The maximum number of items displayed in the Recently Viewed Products block. Can differ per store view.

field.comment: Turns product reviews on or off on the storefront.
field.modal: Controls whether the **Product Reviews** feature is available on the storefront, letting shoppers read and submit reviews. Can be set per website or store view.

field.comment: Whether visitors who aren't logged in can submit product reviews.
field.modal: When **Yes**, guests who are not signed-in customers can write product reviews; when **No**, only registered customers can. Applies only when **Product Reviews** is enabled. Can differ per website.

field.comment: Maximum number of suggestions shown in the search autocomplete dropdown.
field.modal: Caps how many suggestions the search box shows as the shopper types.

field.comment: Whether HTTP authentication is used when connecting to Elasticsearch 8.
field.modal: When Yes, a username and password are sent with requests to the Elasticsearch 8 server. Applies only when the search engine is set to Elasticsearch 8.

field.comment: The prefix added to the names of the Elasticsearch 8 indices.
field.modal: The string prepended to index names in Elasticsearch 8, letting several stores or environments share one cluster without index-name collisions. Applies only when the search engine is set to Elasticsearch 8.

field.comment: The password for Elasticsearch 8 HTTP authentication.
field.modal: The password used together with the user name to authenticate to the Elasticsearch 8 server. Applies only when Elasticsearch 8 is the search engine and HTTP authentication is enabled.

field.comment: The hostname or IP address of the Elasticsearch 8 server.
field.modal: The host where the Elasticsearch 8 cluster is reached. Applies only when the search engine is set to Elasticsearch 8.

field.comment: The TCP port the Elasticsearch 8 server listens on.
field.modal: The port used to connect to the Elasticsearch 8 server. Applies only when the search engine is set to Elasticsearch 8.

field.comment: How long, in seconds, to wait for the Elasticsearch 8 server before timing out.
field.modal: The connection timeout for requests to the Elasticsearch 8 server. Applies only when the search engine is set to Elasticsearch 8.

field.comment: The user name for Elasticsearch 8 HTTP authentication.
field.modal: The account name used to authenticate to the Elasticsearch 8 server. Applies only when Elasticsearch 8 is the search engine and HTTP authentication is enabled.

field.comment: Which search engine backend powers catalog search.
field.modal: Selects the search engine used to index and query the catalog (from the engines installed on the store, such as OpenSearch or Elasticsearch). Changing it typically requires reindexing.

field.comment: Whether to send HTTP authentication credentials when connecting to OpenSearch.
field.modal: When **Yes**, Magento authenticates to OpenSearch using the configured username and password. Applies only when the search engine is set to OpenSearch.

field.comment: A prefix added to OpenSearch index names for this installation.
field.modal: Prepended to the names of the catalog search indexes, letting several installations share one OpenSearch cluster without clashing. Applies only when the search engine is set to OpenSearch.

field.comment: The password for HTTP authentication to OpenSearch.
field.modal: The password used to authenticate to the OpenSearch server. Applies only when the engine is OpenSearch and **Enable OpenSearch HTTP Auth** is set to Yes.

field.comment: The hostname or IP address of the OpenSearch server used for catalog search.
field.modal: The address Magento connects to when indexing and querying catalog search. Applies only when the search engine is set to OpenSearch.

field.comment: The port on which the OpenSearch server accepts connections.
field.modal: The TCP port used to reach the OpenSearch server. Applies only when the search engine is set to OpenSearch.

field.comment: The request timeout for connections to the OpenSearch server.
field.modal: How long Magento waits for an OpenSearch request before timing out. Applies only when the search engine is set to OpenSearch.

field.comment: The username for HTTP authentication to OpenSearch.
field.modal: The user name used to authenticate to the OpenSearch server. Applies only when the engine is OpenSearch and **Enable OpenSearch HTTP Auth** is set to Yes.

field.comment: How many search term recommendations to show.
field.modal: The number of alternative search-term recommendations shown for a query. Applies only when search recommendations are enabled. Can differ per store view.

field.comment: Whether to show the number of results next to each search recommendation.
field.modal: When **Yes**, each search recommendation displays how many results it would return. Applies only when search recommendations are enabled. Can differ per store view.

field.comment: How many search suggestions to show.
field.modal: The number of search suggestions offered for a query. Applies only when search suggestions are enabled. Can differ per store view.

field.comment: Whether a canonical link meta tag is added to category pages.
field.modal: When **Yes**, category pages emit a `rel="canonical"` tag pointing at the preferred URL, helping search engines avoid duplicate-content issues.

field.comment: Whether a canonical link meta tag is added to product pages.
field.modal: When **Yes**, product pages emit a `rel="canonical"` tag pointing at the preferred URL (useful when a product is reachable under multiple category paths).

field.comment: Whether accented/non-Latin characters are transliterated when building product URL keys.
field.modal: When **Yes**, characters like 'é' are converted to ASCII when a product's URL key is generated, producing cleaner URLs.

field.comment: Whether product URLs include their category path.
field.modal: When **Yes**, a product reachable under a category gets a URL that includes the category path (e.g. `/gear/bags/product`). Affects URL structure and canonicalisation.

field.comment: Whether a permanent (301) redirect is created when a product or category URL key changes.
field.modal: When **Yes**, changing a URL key leaves behind a permanent redirect from the old URL, so existing links and search rankings are preserved.

field.comment: Enables the storefront Popular Search Terms page.
field.modal: When enabled, a public page listing popular search terms is published, which can help search engines discover catalog pages.

field.comment: The character placed between parts of the page title.
field.modal: The separator (e.g. `-` or `|`) used to join segments of the HTML page title.

field.comment: How many items are processed per batch in asynchronous admin bulk operations.
field.modal: Sets the number of records handled in each batch when admin bulk stock/source operations run asynchronously. Applies only when asynchronous bulk operations are enabled. Larger batches finish in fewer passes but use more memory per run.

field.comment: Whether credit-memo items are automatically returned to stock.
field.modal: When **Yes**, items on a credit memo are added back to available stock automatically when the credit memo is created.

field.comment: Whether products must be bought in fixed quantity increments.
field.modal: When **Yes**, products can only be purchased in multiples of the Qty Increments value below.

field.comment: Default maximum quantity of a single product allowed in one cart.
field.modal: The store-wide default ceiling on how many of one product a customer can buy in a single order. Can be overridden per product.

field.comment: The quantity at which a product is considered out of stock (out-of-stock threshold).
field.modal: When available stock drops to this level, the product is treated as out of stock. Can be negative to allow backorders below zero.

field.comment: Default minimum quantity of a product that can be purchased.
field.modal: The store-wide default floor on how many of one product must be bought in a single order. Can be overridden per product.

field.comment: Stock level at or below which a low-stock notification is flagged.
field.modal: The threshold used to flag products as low on stock in admin low-stock reports and RSS.

field.comment: The increment a product's purchased quantity must be a multiple of.
field.modal: Cart quantities must be a multiple of this number. Applies only when **Enable Qty Increments** is Yes.

field.comment: Whether items return to In Stock when an order is cancelled.
field.modal: When **Yes**, cancelling an order restores the cancelled items to available stock.

field.comment: Whether stock quantity is reduced when an order is placed.
field.modal: When **Yes**, a product's quantity is decremented as orders are placed. Set to **No** to stop Magento tracking stock levels for sales.

field.comment: Whether product availability (In/Out of Stock) is shown on the storefront.
field.modal: When **Yes**, the storefront displays each product's stock availability.

field.comment: Which message is shown when the requested quantity can't be added to the cart.
field.modal: Selects the wording shown when a product can't be added in the requested quantity (e.g. a generic out-of-stock notice versus a 'requested qty not available' message).

field.comment: Quantity at or below which the storefront shows an 'Only X left' message.
field.modal: Sets the level under which an 'Only X left' urgency message appears on the product page. Set to 0 to disable the message.

field.comment: The travel mode Google uses to measure distance — driving, walking, or bicycling.
field.modal: Chooses the Google travel mode for distance calculation: **Driving**, **Walking**, or **Bicycling**. Used when the Google distance provider is selected.

field.comment: Whether sources are ranked by physical distance or by travel time.
field.modal: Chooses the metric Google returns for ranking sources: **Distance** (physical distance) or **Time to destination** (travel time). Used when the Google distance provider is selected.

field.comment: Which distance provider is used to rank sources for distance-based source selection.
field.modal: Selects the service that calculates the distance between a shipping destination and each source when the Distance Based source selection algorithm runs.

field.comment: Whether the cart shows the chosen variation's image or the configurable parent product's image.
field.modal: Controls which image appears in the shopping cart for a configurable product line: the image of the specific variation the customer selected, or the parent product's image. Can be set per website or store view.

field.comment: Whether cross-sell product suggestions are shown on the shopping cart page.
field.modal: Controls the display of cross-sell ("you might also like") products on the cart page.

field.comment: How many days an inactive cart (quote) is kept before it is cleared.
field.modal: The lifetime, in days, of an abandoned shopping cart. After this period the quote is eligible to be removed by the clean-up process.

field.comment: Whether an "empty cart" button is shown on the shopping cart page.
field.modal: When **Yes**, customers get a button to clear the whole cart in one action.

field.comment: Which image represents a grouped product's items in the cart — the grouped parent's or each associated product's own.
field.modal: Chooses whether the shopping cart shows the grouped (parent) product's image or each associated product's own image for items added as part of a grouped product. Can be set per store view.

field.comment: Whether the cart link counts distinct items or total item quantity.
field.modal: Chooses what the header cart summary counts: the number of distinct items in the cart, or the total quantity across all items.

field.comment: Number of cart line items shown per page before pagination appears.
field.modal: How many items the shopping cart lists on one page; once the cart holds more, a pager is shown.

field.comment: Whether adding a product sends the shopper straight to the cart or leaves them on the page.
field.modal: When **Yes**, adding a product redirects to the shopping cart page. When **No**, the shopper stays where they are (typically with a mini-cart update).

field.comment: Whether the billing address is collected on the payment step or on its own checkout page.
field.modal: Chooses where the billing address is asked for: on the **Payment Method** step, or on a separate **Payment Page**.

field.comment: Turns the Terms and Conditions step on at checkout.
field.modal: When **Yes**, the configured Terms and Conditions are shown at checkout and must be accepted before an order can be placed. Can be set per store view.

field.comment: Lets shoppers place an order without creating or signing into an account.
field.modal: When **Yes**, customers can check out as a guest. When **No**, they must register or sign in before they can place an order.

field.comment: How many line items the order summary lists before the rest are collapsed.
field.modal: The number of items shown in the checkout order summary; any beyond this are hidden behind a toggle to keep the summary short.

field.comment: Turns the one-page checkout flow on or off for the storefront.
field.modal: Controls whether customers check out through Magento's single-page checkout. Set to **No** to disable it (for example when a custom checkout replaces it).

field.comment: How copies of the payment-failed email are sent — blind copy or a separate email.
field.modal: Chooses how additional recipients receive the payment-failure notice: as a **Bcc** on the original email, or as a **Separate Email**.

field.comment: Which store email identity the "payment failed" notification is sent from.
field.modal: The sender identity for payment-failure emails — one of the **Store Email Addresses** identities (General Contact, Sales Representative, Customer Support, Custom 1/2).

field.comment: Which store email identity receives the "payment failed" notification.
field.modal: The internal recipient of payment-failure emails, chosen from the configured **Store Email Addresses** identities.

field.comment: How many of the most recent items the mini-cart shows before it scrolls.
field.modal: The number of items visible in the mini-cart before its list becomes scrollable.

field.comment: Whether the mini-cart dropdown is shown in the page header.
field.modal: Controls the header mini-cart. Set to **No** to hide the dropdown cart preview.

field.comment: Maximum number of items the mini-cart will list.
field.modal: An upper bound on how many items the mini-cart renders, regardless of cart size, to keep the dropdown manageable.

field.comment: Turns Page Builder template import and export on or off.
field.modal: When set to **Yes**, the import and export actions for Page Builder templates are available in the admin, letting you move templates between stores.

field.comment: Selects which WYSIWYG editor adapter is used for content fields.
field.modal: Selects the WYSIWYG editor adapter used for rich-text content fields. Relates to the Enable WYSIWYG Editor setting. Can be set per website.

field.comment: Whether and how the WYSIWYG rich-text editor is available for content fields.
field.modal: Controls whether the WYSIWYG rich-text editor is available for content fields and how it is presented. Can be set per website or store view.

field.comment: Turns the storefront Contact Us page and form on or off.
field.modal: Controls whether the **Contact Us** page and its `/contact` form are available on the storefront. Set to **No** to remove the page entirely. Can be set per website or store view, so the form can be live on one store and hidden on another.

field.comment: The email address that receives messages submitted through the Contact Us form.
field.modal: The inbox that Contact Us submissions are delivered to. Applies only when **Enable Contact Us** is set to Yes. Can differ per website or store view, so each store can route enquiries to its own team.

field.comment: Which store email identity the Contact Us notification is sent from.
field.modal: Selects the sender identity used for the Contact Us notification — one of the **Store Email Addresses** identities (General Contact, Sales Representative, Customer Support, Custom 1/2), configured under *Stores → Configuration → General → Store Email Addresses*. Applies only when **Enable Contact Us** is Yes.

field.comment: The API key used to authenticate with the Currency Converter API service.
field.modal: The credential for the **Currency Converter API** rate provider. Stored encrypted.

field.comment: How many seconds to wait for the Currency Converter API service before timing out.
field.modal: The connection timeout, in seconds, for currency rate requests to the **Currency Converter API** service.

field.comment: The API key used to authenticate with the Fixer (APILayer) exchange-rate service.
field.modal: The credential for the **Fixer API (APILayer)** currency rate provider. Stored encrypted.

field.comment: How many seconds to wait for the Fixer (APILayer) rate service before timing out.
field.modal: The connection timeout, in seconds, for currency rate requests to the **Fixer API (APILayer)** service.

field.comment: How many seconds to wait for the legacy Fixer.io rate service before timing out.
field.modal: The connection timeout, in seconds, for currency rate requests to the legacy **Fixer.io** service.

field.comment: Whether exchange rates are imported automatically on a schedule.
field.modal: When **Yes**, currency rates are fetched automatically from the configured service on the chosen frequency. Can differ per website or store view.

field.comment: The email address notified when a scheduled currency rate import fails.
field.modal: The recipient for failure notifications from the scheduled rate import. Applies only when scheduled import is **Enabled**. Can differ per website or store view.

field.comment: Which store email identity sends the scheduled-import failure notification.
field.modal: Selects the sender identity for rate-import failure emails — one of the **Store Email Addresses** identities (General Contact, Sales Representative, Customer Support, Custom 1/2). Applies only when scheduled import is **Enabled**. Can differ per website.

field.comment: How often the scheduled currency rate import runs.
field.modal: The cron frequency for the automatic rate import: **Daily**, **Weekly**, or **Monthly**. Applies only when scheduled import is **Enabled**. Can differ per website or store view.

field.comment: Which exchange-rate provider the scheduled import pulls rates from.
field.modal: Selects the rate service used by the scheduled import (the configured currency import providers). Applies only when scheduled import is **Enabled**. Can differ per website or store view.

field.comment: The time of day the scheduled currency rate import runs.
field.modal: The start time (hour, minute, second) for the automatic rate import. Applies only when scheduled import is **Enabled**. Can differ per website or store view.

field.comment: The currencies shoppers can switch between on the storefront.
field.modal: The set of currencies made available on the storefront; the **Default Display Currency** must be one of them. Can differ per website or store view.

field.comment: The currency the storefront displays prices in by default.
field.modal: The base display currency shown to shoppers. It must be one of the **Allowed Currencies**. Can differ per website or store view.

field.comment: Whether customers must re-confirm their email address after changing it.
field.modal: When **Yes**, a customer who changes their account email must confirm the new address before it takes effect. Can differ per website.

field.comment: Whether a customer account is shared across all stores or kept separate per website.
field.modal: Sets account scope: **Global** lets a customer sign in on every website with one account; **Per Website** keeps accounts isolated, so the same email can register independently on each website.

field.comment: Whether Company is hidden, optional, or required on address forms.
field.modal: Controls the Company field: **No** hides it, **Optional** shows it without requiring it, **Required** makes it mandatory. Applies to address forms. Can differ per website.

field.comment: Whether Date of Birth is hidden, optional, or required on registration and address forms.
field.modal: Controls the Date of Birth field: **No** hides it, **Optional** shows it without requiring it, **Required** makes it mandatory. Applies to the registration and address forms. Can differ per website.

field.comment: Whether Fax is hidden, optional, or required on address forms.
field.modal: Controls the Fax field: **No** hides it, **Optional** shows it without requiring it, **Required** makes it mandatory. Applies to address forms. Can differ per website.

field.comment: Whether Gender is hidden, optional, or required on registration and address forms.
field.modal: Controls the Gender field: **No** hides it, **Optional** shows it without requiring it, **Required** makes it mandatory. Applies to the registration and address forms. Can differ per website.

field.comment: Whether the Tax/VAT Number is hidden, optional, or required on registration and address forms.
field.modal: Controls the Tax/VAT Number field: **No** hides it, **Optional** shows it without requiring it, **Required** makes it mandatory. Applies to the registration and address forms. Can differ per website.

field.comment: Whether Telephone is hidden, optional, or required on address forms.
field.modal: Controls the Telephone field: **No** hides it, **Optional** shows it without requiring it, **Required** makes it mandatory. Applies to address forms. Can differ per website.

field.comment: The template that controls how an address is formatted on a single line.
field.modal: The formatting template applied when an address is rendered inline on one line. Can differ per website or store view.

field.comment: The template that controls how addresses are formatted in generated PDF documents.
field.modal: The formatting template applied to addresses printed in PDF documents such as invoices and shipments. Can differ per website or store view.

field.comment: The template that controls how addresses are formatted as plain text.
field.modal: The formatting template applied when an address is rendered as a text block. Edit the variables and layout to change how addresses appear. Can differ per website or store view.

field.comment: Whether storefront CAPTCHA answers must match letter case.
field.modal: When **Yes**, the entered CAPTCHA text must match the case of the displayed characters. Applies only when Enable CAPTCHA on Storefront is Yes. Can be set per website.

field.comment: Turns the built-in image CAPTCHA on or off for storefront forms.
field.modal: When **Yes**, the legacy image CAPTCHA is required on the selected storefront forms; **No** disables it. Can be set per website.

field.comment: The font used to render the storefront CAPTCHA image.
field.modal: Selects which configured font the CAPTCHA characters are drawn with. Applies only when Enable CAPTCHA on Storefront is Yes. Can be set per website.

field.comment: When the storefront CAPTCHA is shown — e.g. always or after failed attempts.
field.modal: Chooses when a CAPTCHA is required, such as always or only after a number of failed attempts. Applies only when Enable CAPTCHA on Storefront is Yes. Can be set per website.

field.comment: How many minutes a displayed storefront CAPTCHA stays valid before expiring.
field.modal: The lifetime, in minutes, of a displayed CAPTCHA before a new one must be generated. Applies only when Enable CAPTCHA on Storefront is Yes. Can be set per website.

field.comment: Whether new accounts are automatically placed in a customer group based on VAT ID validation.
field.modal: When **Yes**, new accounts are assigned to a customer group according to their VAT ID validation result, using the group settings below. Can differ per website or store view.

field.comment: Whether new customers must confirm their email address before the account becomes active.
field.modal: When **Yes**, newly registered customers receive a confirmation email and must verify their address before they can sign in. Can differ per website.

field.comment: The customer group assigned to newly created accounts.
field.modal: The default customer group new accounts are placed in, chosen from the store's configured customer groups. Can differ per website or store view.

field.comment: Which store email identity sends the new-account welcome email.
field.modal: Selects the sender identity for the welcome email — one of the **Store Email Addresses** identities (General Contact, Sales Representative, Customer Support, Custom 1/2), set under *General → Store Email Addresses*. Can differ per website or store view.

field.comment: Whether new accounts receive a human-friendly customer ID instead of the raw entity ID.
field.modal: When **Yes**, new customer accounts are assigned a human-friendly identifier rather than the internal sequential database ID.

field.comment: Which address — billing or shipping — is used to validate the VAT ID for group assignment.
field.modal: Chooses whether the **Billing Address** or **Shipping Address** drives VAT ID validation and tax calculation. Applies only when **Enable Automatic Assignment to Customer Group** is set to Yes. Can differ per website or store view.

field.comment: The default value of each customer's flag that disables automatic VAT-based group changes.
field.modal: Sets the initial value of the per-customer **Disable Automatic Group Changes Based on VAT ID** flag. When **Yes**, VAT-based group reassignment is turned off by default for new customers.

field.comment: The customer group assigned when a customer's VAT ID is valid and domestic.
field.modal: The group a customer is moved to when VAT ID validation returns a valid, domestic result. Applies only when **Enable Automatic Assignment to Customer Group** is Yes. Can differ per website or store view.

field.comment: The customer group assigned when VAT ID validation cannot be completed.
field.modal: The group a customer is moved to when VAT ID validation fails to complete (for example a service error). Applies only when **Enable Automatic Assignment to Customer Group** is Yes. Can differ per website or store view.

field.comment: The customer group assigned when a customer's VAT ID is a valid intra-union (EU) number.
