field.comment: Installment period shown on the Brazil installment PayPal button at checkout.
field.modal: Selects the installment period for the Brazil installment button on the checkout page. Applies only when button customization is enabled and the button label is set to Installment. Can be set per website or store view.

field.comment: Color of the PayPal smart button on the checkout page.
field.modal: Chooses the color of the PayPal button shown on the **Checkout Page**, from the available button colors. Applies only when button customization is enabled for that location. Can be set per website and per store view.

field.comment: Whether to customize the PayPal button's appearance on the checkout page.
field.modal: When **Yes**, you can override the default style of the PayPal button on the checkout page; **No** keeps the defaults. Can be set per store view.

field.comment: Layout of the PayPal Credit smart button on the checkout page.
field.modal: Chooses the layout of the PayPal Credit smart button shown on the checkout page. Applies only when the checkout-page button is customized with the credit label. Can differ per store view.

field.comment: Installment period shown on the PayPal button for Mexico on the checkout page.
field.modal: Sets the Mexico installment period presented on the checkout-page PayPal smart button, from PayPal's available periods. Applies only when button customization is enabled and the button label is set to the installment option. Can be set per website or store view.

field.comment: Corner shape of the PayPal Smart Payment Button on the checkout page.
field.modal: Sets the shape of the PayPal **Smart Button** rendered on the checkout page. Applies only when checkout-page button customization is enabled. Can be set per store view.

field.comment: Installment period shown on the Brazil installment PayPal button in the mini cart.
field.modal: Selects the installment period for the Brazil installment button in the mini cart. Applies only when button customization is enabled and the button label is set to Installment. Can be set per website or store view.

field.comment: Color of the PayPal smart button in the mini cart.
field.modal: Chooses the color of the PayPal button shown in the **Mini Cart**, from the available button colors. Applies only when button customization is enabled for that location. Can be set per website and per store view.

field.comment: Whether to customize the PayPal button's appearance in the mini cart.
field.modal: When **Yes**, you can override the default style of the PayPal button in the mini cart; **No** keeps the defaults. Can be set per store view.

field.comment: Layout of the PayPal Credit smart button in the mini cart.
field.modal: Chooses the layout of the PayPal Credit smart button shown in the mini cart. Applies only when the mini-cart button is customized with the credit label. Can differ per store view.

field.comment: Installment period shown on the PayPal button for Mexico in the mini cart.
field.modal: Sets the Mexico installment period presented on the mini-cart PayPal smart button, from PayPal's available periods. Applies only when button customization is enabled and the button label is set to the installment option. Can be set per website or store view.

field.comment: Corner shape of the PayPal Smart Payment Button in the mini cart.
field.modal: Sets the shape of the PayPal **Smart Button** rendered in the mini cart. Applies only when checkout-page and mini-cart button customization are enabled. Can be set per store view.

field.comment: Name of a custom PayPal-hosted payment page style to apply.
field.modal: The name of a custom payment page layout (page style) configured in the merchant's PayPal account, applied to the PayPal-hosted pages shown during checkout. Can be set per website or store view.

field.comment: Background color of the header area on PayPal-hosted checkout pages.
field.modal: Sets the header background color shown on PayPal-hosted pages during checkout, part of the **Frontend Experience Settings**. Can be set per website and per store view.

field.comment: Color of the header border shown on PayPal-hosted pages.
field.modal: Sets the color used for the border of the header area on PayPal-hosted checkout pages. Can be set per store view.

field.comment: URL of the image shown in the header of PayPal-hosted checkout pages.
field.modal: The image URL displayed at the top of the PayPal-hosted pages customers see during checkout. Can differ per store view.

field.comment: Installment period shown on the Brazil installment PayPal button on product pages.
field.modal: Selects the installment period for the Brazil installment button on product pages. Applies only when button customization is enabled and the button label is set to Installment. Can be set per website or store view.

field.comment: Color of the PayPal smart button on product detail pages.
field.modal: Chooses the color of the PayPal button shown on **Product Pages**, from the available button colors. Applies only when button customization is enabled for that location. Can be set per website and per store view.

field.comment: Whether to customize the PayPal button's appearance on product pages.
field.modal: When **Yes**, you can override the default style of the PayPal button on product pages; **No** keeps the defaults. Can be set per store view.

field.comment: Layout of the PayPal Credit smart button on product pages.
field.modal: Chooses the layout of the PayPal Credit smart button shown on product pages. Applies only when the product-page button is customized with the credit label. Can differ per store view.

field.comment: Installment period shown on the PayPal button for Mexico on product pages.
field.modal: Sets the Mexico installment period presented on the product-page PayPal smart button, from PayPal's available periods. Applies only when button customization is enabled and the button label is set to the installment option. Can be set per website or store view.

field.comment: Corner shape of the PayPal Smart Payment Button on product pages.
field.modal: Sets the shape of the PayPal **Smart Button** rendered on product pages. Applies only when checkout-page and product-page button customization are enabled. Can be set per store view.

field.comment: Whether PayPal settlement reports are fetched automatically on a schedule.
field.modal: When **Yes**, settlement reports are retrieved from PayPal automatically on a schedule; **No** requires fetching them manually.

field.comment: Username used to sign in to the server where PayPal settlement reports are fetched.
field.modal: The login used to authenticate to the (S)FTP server from which settlement reports are downloaded. Stored encrypted. Can be set per website.

field.comment: The SFTP password used to fetch PayPal settlement reports.
field.modal: The password for the SFTP account PayPal uses to deliver settlement reports. Stored encrypted. Can be set per website.

field.comment: Whether settlement reports are fetched from PayPal's sandbox server instead of the live one.
field.modal: When **Yes**, PayPal settlement reports are retrieved from the **sandbox** (test) SFTP server rather than the production server. Can be set per website.

field.comment: Time of day when the PayPal settlement report is fetched.
field.modal: Sets the time of day at which Magento retrieves the settlement report from PayPal, part of **Settlement Report Settings**.

field.comment: Whether individual cart line items are sent to PayPal with the order.
field.modal: When **Yes**, each cart line item is transferred to PayPal so the itemized breakdown appears on the PayPal side; when **No**, only the order total is sent. Can be set per website.

field.comment: Whether the order review step is skipped after returning from PayPal.
field.modal: When **Yes**, the order is placed immediately after PayPal instead of showing the order review page; **No** keeps the review step.

field.comment: Countries PayPal Express Checkout is offered to when limited to specific countries.
field.modal: Selects which countries can use PayPal Express Checkout. Applies only when Payment Applicable From is set to specific countries. Can be set per website.

field.comment: Whether SSL/TLS peer verification is enforced on Express Checkout API connections.
field.modal: When **Yes**, the SSL certificate of PayPal's endpoint is verified on Express Checkout API connections; when **No**, verification is skipped. Can be set per website.

field.comment: Display order of PayPal Express Checkout among payment methods at checkout.
field.modal: Sets the position of PayPal Express Checkout in the list of payment methods at checkout (lower numbers appear first). Can be set per store view.

field.comment: Whether the PayPal Express Checkout button appears on product detail pages.
field.modal: **Yes** shows the PayPal Express Checkout button on product detail pages; **No** hides it. Can be set per website or store view.

field.comment: Whether the PayPal Pay Later banner is shown on the storefront category page.
field.modal: Turns the **PayPal Pay Later** (Bill Me Later) promotional banner on or off on the **category** page. Can be set per website.

field.comment: Placement of the PayPal Pay Later (BML) banner on catalog category pages.
field.modal: Chooses where the **Pay Later / Bill Me Later** promotional banner appears on catalog category pages. Can be set per website.

field.comment: Size of the PayPal Credit (Bill Me Later) banner shown on catalog category pages.
field.modal: Chooses the display size of the PayPal Credit / Bill Me Later promotional banner on the **Catalog Category Page**, from the available banner sizes. Applies only for the configured category-page banner position, and can be set per website.

field.comment: Size of the PayPal Credit (Bill Me Later) banner shown on catalog category pages.
field.modal: Chooses the display size of the PayPal Credit / Bill Me Later promotional banner on the **Catalog Category Page**, from the available banner sizes. Applies only for the configured category-page banner position, and can be set per website.

field.comment: Shows the PayPal Bill Me Later promotional banner on the shopping cart page.
field.modal: When **Yes**, the PayPal Bill Me Later (PayPal Credit) banner appears on the shopping cart page; **No** hides it.

field.comment: Placement of the PayPal Credit (BML) banner on the checkout shopping cart page.
field.modal: Chooses where the PayPal Credit (Pay Later/BML) advertising banner appears on the checkout cart page. The available placements come from PayPal's banner position options. Can be set per website.

field.comment: Display size of the PayPal Credit (BML) banner on the shopping cart page.
field.modal: Sets the size of the PayPal Credit / Banner-based-lending promo banner shown on the **Checkout Cart Page**. Applies only when the cart-page banner's **Position** is set to the matching layout option. Can be set per website.

field.comment: Display size of the PayPal Credit (BML) banner on the shopping cart page.
field.modal: Sets the size of the PayPal Credit / Banner-based-lending promo banner shown on the **Checkout Cart Page**. Applies only when the cart-page banner's **Position** is set to the matching layout option. Can be set per website.

field.comment: Whether the PayPal Pay Later banner is shown on the storefront home page.
field.modal: Turns the **PayPal Pay Later** (Bill Me Later) promotional banner on or off on the **home** page. Can be set per website.

field.comment: Placement of the PayPal Pay Later (BML) banner on the storefront home page.
field.modal: Chooses where the **Pay Later / Bill Me Later** promotional banner appears on the home page. Can be set per website.

field.comment: Size of the PayPal Credit (Bill Me Later) banner shown on the home page.
field.modal: Chooses the display size of the PayPal Credit / Bill Me Later promotional banner on the **Home Page**, from the available banner sizes. Applies only for the configured home-page banner position, and can be set per website.

field.comment: Size of the PayPal Credit (Bill Me Later) banner shown on the home page.
field.modal: Chooses the display size of the PayPal Credit / Bill Me Later promotional banner on the **Home Page**, from the available banner sizes. Applies only for the configured home-page banner position, and can be set per website.

field.comment: Shows the PayPal Bill Me Later promotional banner on catalog product pages.
field.modal: When **Yes**, the PayPal Bill Me Later (PayPal Credit) banner appears on catalog product pages; **No** hides it.

field.comment: Placement of the PayPal Credit (BML) banner on the catalog product page.
field.modal: Chooses where the PayPal Credit (Pay Later/BML) advertising banner appears on product detail pages. Placements come from PayPal's banner position options. Can be set per website.

field.comment: Display size of the PayPal Credit (BML) banner on the product page.
field.modal: Sets the size of the PayPal Credit / Banner-based-lending promo banner shown on the **Catalog Product Page**. Applies only when the product-page banner's **Position** is set to the matching layout option. Can be set per website.

field.comment: Display size of the PayPal Credit (BML) banner on the product page.
field.modal: Sets the size of the PayPal Credit / Banner-based-lending promo banner shown on the **Catalog Product Page**. Applies only when the product-page banner's **Position** is set to the matching layout option. Can be set per website.

field.comment: Turns PayPal Pay Later promotional banners on or off across the storefront.
field.modal: Master switch for advertising **PayPal Pay Later** messaging. When **Yes**, the Pay Later banners configured for each page are eligible to show. Can be set per website.

field.comment: Color of the PayPal Pay Later banner on the shopping cart page.
field.modal: Selects the color variant of the **Pay Later** banner shown on the cart page. Applies only when the cart-page Pay Later banner is displayed and its style layout is set to flex. Can be set per website.

field.comment: Whether the PayPal Pay Later message is shown on the shopping cart page.
field.modal: When **Yes**, the PayPal Pay Later promotional message appears on the **Checkout Cart Page**; when **No**, it is hidden. Can be set per website.

field.comment: Placement of the logo within the PayPal Pay Later banner on the cart page.
field.modal: Sets where the logo sits inside the Pay Later messaging banner on the shopping cart page. Applies only when the cart-page Pay Later banner is displayed with a text style layout.

field.comment: Logo variant for the PayPal Pay Later message on the shopping cart page.
field.modal: Selects which PayPal Pay Later logo style is shown in the cart-page message. Applies only when the cart-page Pay Later message is displayed and its style layout is set to text. Can be set per website.

field.comment: Where the PayPal Pay Later banner is placed on the shopping cart page.
field.modal: Chooses the placement of the Pay Later banner on the **Checkout Cart Page** from the available positions. Applies only when the cart-page Pay Later banner **Display** is enabled. Can be set per website.

field.comment: Aspect ratio of the flex-layout PayPal Pay Later banner on the shopping cart page.
field.modal: Chooses the aspect ratio/size of the **flex**-layout PayPal Pay Later banner on the cart page. Applies only when that banner is displayed and its style layout is **flex**. Can be set per website.

field.comment: Layout style of the PayPal Pay Later banner on the shopping cart page.
field.modal: Selects the layout style of the **Pay Later** banner on the cart page. Applies only when the cart-page Pay Later banner is displayed. Can be set per website.

field.comment: Text color of the PayPal Pay Later message on the cart page.
field.modal: Selects the text color of the PayPal Pay Later message on the **Checkout Cart Page**, from the available color options. Applies only when the cart-page Pay Later message is enabled and its style layout is set to Text. Can be set per website.

field.comment: Text size of the PayPal Pay Later banner on the cart page.
field.modal: Sets the size of the message text in the Pay Later banner on the shopping cart page. Applies only when the cart-page Pay Later banner is displayed with a text style layout.

field.comment: Color scheme for the PayPal Pay Later message on catalog category pages.
field.modal: Selects the color scheme of the PayPal Pay Later banner shown on catalog category pages. Applies only when the category-page Pay Later message is displayed and its style layout is set to flex. Can be set per website.

field.comment: Whether the PayPal Pay Later banner is shown on category pages.
field.modal: When **Yes**, the PayPal Pay Later promotional banner appears on the **Catalog Category Page**; when **No**, it is hidden. Can be set per website.

field.comment: Position of the PayPal logo within the Pay Later text banner on the category page.
field.modal: Where the PayPal logo sits within the **text**-layout Pay Later banner on the category page. Applies only when that banner is displayed with a text style layout and a primary/alternative logo type. Can be set per website.

field.comment: Logo style of the PayPal Pay Later banner on catalog category pages.
field.modal: Selects the logo style of the **Pay Later** banner on category pages. Applies only when the category-page Pay Later banner is displayed and its style layout is set to text. Can be set per website.

field.comment: Placement of the PayPal Pay Later message on catalog category pages.
field.modal: Chooses where the PayPal Pay Later message is placed on the **Catalog Category Page**, from the available positions. Applies only when the category-page Pay Later message is enabled. Can be set per website.

field.comment: Aspect ratio of the PayPal Pay Later banner on category pages.
field.modal: Sets the shape/aspect ratio of the Pay Later banner on catalog category pages. Applies only when the category-page Pay Later banner is displayed with a flex style layout.

field.comment: Layout style of the PayPal Pay Later message on catalog category pages.
field.modal: Chooses the layout format of the PayPal Pay Later banner on catalog category pages, which in turn determines whether a logo-type or color option applies. Applies only when the category-page Pay Later message is displayed. Can be set per website.

field.comment: Text color of the Pay Later banner on category pages.
field.modal: Selects the text color for the Pay Later banner on the **Catalog Category Page** from PayPal's allowed color options. Applies only when the category-page banner **Display** is enabled and its style layout is **Text**. Can be set per website.

field.comment: Text size of the PayPal Pay Later text banner on the category page.
field.modal: Sets the text size of the **text**-layout PayPal Pay Later banner on the category page. Applies only when that banner is displayed with a text style layout. Can be set per website.

field.comment: Color of the PayPal Pay Later banner on the checkout payment step.
field.modal: Selects the color variant of the **Pay Later** banner shown on the checkout payment step. Applies only when that banner is displayed and its style layout is set to flex. Can be set per website.

field.comment: Whether the PayPal Pay Later message is shown at the checkout payment step.
field.modal: When **Yes**, the PayPal Pay Later promotional message appears at the **Checkout Payment Step**; when **No**, it is hidden. Can be set per website.

field.comment: Placement of the logo within the PayPal Pay Later banner at the checkout payment step.
field.modal: Sets where the logo sits inside the Pay Later banner on the checkout payment step. Applies only when that Pay Later banner is displayed with a text style layout.

field.comment: Logo variant for the PayPal Pay Later message on the checkout payment step.
field.modal: Selects which PayPal Pay Later logo style is shown during the checkout payment step. Applies only when that Pay Later message is displayed and its style layout is set to text. Can be set per website.

field.comment: Where the PayPal Pay Later banner is placed at the checkout payment step.
field.modal: Chooses the placement of the Pay Later banner on the **Checkout Payment Step** from the available positions. Applies only when the payment-step Pay Later banner **Display** is enabled. Can be set per website.

field.comment: Aspect ratio of the flex-layout PayPal Pay Later banner on the checkout payment step.
field.modal: Chooses the aspect ratio/size of the **flex**-layout PayPal Pay Later banner on the checkout payment step. Applies only when that banner is displayed and its style layout is **flex**. Can be set per website.

field.comment: Layout style of the PayPal Pay Later banner on the checkout payment step.
field.modal: Selects the layout style of the **Pay Later** banner on the checkout payment step. Applies only when that banner is displayed. Can be set per website.

field.comment: Text color of the PayPal Pay Later message at the checkout payment step.
field.modal: Selects the text color of the PayPal Pay Later message at the **Checkout Payment Step**, from the available color options. Applies only when that message is enabled and its style layout is set to Text. Can be set per website.

field.comment: Text size of the PayPal Pay Later banner at the checkout payment step.
field.modal: Sets the size of the message text in the Pay Later banner on the checkout payment step. Applies only when that Pay Later banner is displayed with a text style layout.

field.comment: Color scheme for the PayPal Pay Later message on the home page.
field.modal: Selects the color scheme of the PayPal Pay Later banner shown on the storefront home page. Applies only when the home-page Pay Later message is displayed and its style layout is set to flex. Can be set per website.

field.comment: Whether the PayPal Pay Later banner is shown on the home page.
field.modal: When **Yes**, the PayPal Pay Later promotional banner appears on the **Home Page**; when **No**, it is hidden. Can be set per website.

field.comment: Position of the PayPal logo within the Pay Later text banner on the home page.
field.modal: Where the PayPal logo sits within the **text**-layout Pay Later banner on the home page. Applies only when that banner is displayed with a text style layout and a primary/alternative logo type. Can be set per website.

field.comment: Logo style of the PayPal Pay Later banner on the storefront home page.
field.modal: Selects the logo style of the **Pay Later** banner on the home page. Applies only when the home-page Pay Later banner is displayed and its style layout is set to text. Can be set per website.

field.comment: Placement of the PayPal Pay Later message on the home page.
field.modal: Chooses where the PayPal Pay Later message is placed on the **Home Page**, from the available positions. Applies only when the home-page Pay Later message is enabled. Can be set per website.

field.comment: Aspect ratio of the PayPal Pay Later banner on the home page.
field.modal: Sets the shape/aspect ratio of the Pay Later banner on the home page. Applies only when the home-page Pay Later banner is displayed with a flex style layout.

field.comment: Layout style of the PayPal Pay Later message on the home page.
field.modal: Chooses the layout format of the PayPal Pay Later banner on the home page. Applies only when the home-page Pay Later message is displayed. Can be set per website.

field.comment: Text color of the Pay Later banner on the home page.
field.modal: Selects the text color for the Pay Later banner on the **Home Page** from PayPal's allowed color options. Applies only when the home-page banner **Display** is enabled and its style layout is **Text**. Can be set per website.

field.comment: Text size of the PayPal Pay Later text banner on the home page.
field.modal: Sets the text size of the **text**-layout PayPal Pay Later banner on the home page. Applies only when that banner is displayed with a text style layout. Can be set per website.

field.comment: Color of the PayPal Pay Later banner on product detail pages.
field.modal: Selects the color variant of the **Pay Later** banner shown on product pages. Applies only when that banner is displayed and its style layout is set to flex. Can be set per website.

field.comment: Whether the PayPal Pay Later message is shown on product detail pages.
field.modal: When **Yes**, the PayPal Pay Later promotional message appears on the **Catalog Product Page**; when **No**, it is hidden. Can be set per website.

field.comment: Placement of the logo within the PayPal Pay Later banner on product pages.
field.modal: Sets where the logo sits inside the Pay Later banner on catalog product pages. Applies only when the product-page Pay Later banner is displayed with a text style layout.

field.comment: Logo variant for the PayPal Pay Later message on product pages.
field.modal: Selects which PayPal Pay Later logo style is shown in the product-page message. Applies only when the product-page Pay Later message is displayed and its style layout is set to text. Can be set per website.

field.comment: Where the PayPal Pay Later banner is placed on product pages.
field.modal: Chooses the placement of the Pay Later banner on the **Catalog Product Page** from the available positions. Applies only when the product-page Pay Later banner **Display** is enabled. Can be set per website.

field.comment: Aspect ratio of the flex-layout PayPal Pay Later banner on the product page.
field.modal: Chooses the aspect ratio/size of the **flex**-layout PayPal Pay Later banner on the catalog product page. Applies only when that banner is displayed and its style layout is **flex**. Can be set per website.

field.comment: Layout style of the PayPal Pay Later banner on product detail pages.
field.modal: Selects the layout style of the **Pay Later** banner on product pages. Applies only when the product-page Pay Later banner is displayed. Can be set per website.

field.comment: Text color of the PayPal Pay Later message on product detail pages.
field.modal: Selects the text color of the PayPal Pay Later message on the **Catalog Product Page**, from the available color options. Applies only when the product-page message is enabled and its style layout is set to Text. Can be set per website.

field.comment: Text size of the PayPal Pay Later banner on product pages.
field.modal: Sets the size of the message text in the Pay Later banner on catalog product pages. Applies only when the product-page Pay Later banner is displayed with a text style layout.

field.comment: Enables the PayPal Express Checkout payment solution.
field.modal: Turns PayPal Express Checkout on or off (Yes/No). Can be set per website.

field.comment: Enables or disables the PayPal Pay Later experience.
field.modal: Turns the PayPal Pay Later experience on or off for this PayPal solution. When **No**, Pay Later messaging and banners are not offered. Can be set per website.

field.comment: Display order of PayPal Credit relative to other payment methods at checkout.
field.modal: Sets the position of **PayPal Credit** among the available payment methods at checkout (lower numbers appear first). Applies only when Express Checkout PayPal Credit is enabled.

field.comment: The method used to authenticate Magento's calls to the PayPal API.
field.modal: Selects how the store authenticates to PayPal's API for Express Checkout (for example, by the type of API credential used). Can be set per website.

field.comment: API certificate file used to authenticate the store's PayPal account for Express Checkout.
field.modal: Uploads the PayPal API certificate that identifies and authenticates the merchant's PayPal account for **Express Checkout** API calls. Used instead of API signature credentials when certificate authentication is selected. Can be set per website.

field.comment: Password that authenticates Express Checkout API calls to the merchant's PayPal account.
field.modal: The API password used to authenticate Express Checkout API requests against the merchant's PayPal account. Stored encrypted, and can differ per website.

field.comment: API signature credential used to authenticate the store with your PayPal account.
field.modal: The PayPal API signature that authenticates requests from the store to your PayPal account. Stored encrypted. Applies when API signature authentication is in use. Can be set per website.

field.comment: The PayPal API username that identifies the merchant's account for Express Checkout.
field.modal: The API username used to identify and authenticate the merchant's PayPal account for Express Checkout API calls. Stored encrypted. Can be set per website.

field.comment: Country used to simulate the buyer's location when testing Express Checkout in sandbox mode.
field.modal: Selects a buyer country, from the country list, to emulate during **sandbox** testing of PayPal Express Checkout. Applies only when sandbox mode is enabled. Can be set per website.

field.comment: Hostname or IP of the proxy server used for PayPal API calls.
field.modal: The proxy host that PayPal API requests are routed through. Applies only when **Use Proxy** is enabled. Can be set per website.

field.comment: Whether Express Checkout runs against the PayPal sandbox instead of the live environment.
field.modal: When **Yes**, Express Checkout uses the PayPal sandbox for testing; when **No**, it processes live transactions. Can be set per website.

field.comment: Whether PayPal API calls are routed through a proxy server.
field.modal: When **Yes**, Express Checkout API requests are sent through a proxy host; **No** connects to PayPal directly.

field.comment: Merchant Account ID that identifies your PayPal account for In-Context Checkout.
field.modal: Your PayPal merchant account identifier, used to associate the store with your PayPal account. Applies only when In-Context Checkout is enabled. Can be set per website.

field.comment: The payment action used when an order is placed through PayPal Express Checkout.
field.modal: Selects how a PayPal Express Checkout order is processed at placement — the payment action applied to the transaction. Can be set per website.

field.comment: Whether PayPal Express Checkout applies to all allowed countries or only specific ones.
field.modal: Chooses whether PayPal Express Checkout is offered to **all allowed countries** or only to a **specific** list of countries (set in the related country field). Can be set per website.

field.comment: Visual style of the PayPal Express Checkout shortcut buttons.
field.modal: Selects the visual flavor of the PayPal shortcut (Express Checkout) buttons shown in the storefront. Can be set per website or store view.

field.comment: Whether PayPal Express Checkout API calls are logged for debugging.
field.modal: When **Yes**, requests and responses exchanged with PayPal for Express Checkout are written to the debug log. Can be set per website.

field.comment: Whether customers can create a PayPal billing agreement from their account.
field.modal: When **Yes**, customers can set up a PayPal billing agreement through the wizard in their account area; **No** disables it.

field.comment: Whether the PayPal Billing Agreement method is offered to all countries or only selected ones.
field.modal: Chooses whether PayPal Billing Agreement is available from all allowed countries or only a specific list. When restricted, the countries are chosen in a separate setting. Can be set per website.

field.comment: Logs PayPal API request and response data for Billing Agreement troubleshooting.
field.modal: When **Yes**, PayPal Billing Agreement API calls are logged to help with troubleshooting; when **No**, logging is off. Can be set per website.

field.comment: Whether individual cart line items are sent to PayPal for billing-agreement orders.
field.modal: When **Yes**, each cart line item (name, quantity, price) is transferred to PayPal rather than only the order total, for PayPal Billing Agreement transactions. Can be set per website.

field.comment: How PayPal processes payment for billing-agreement orders.
field.modal: Selects the payment action PayPal performs for billing-agreement orders — for example, authorizing the amount only, or authorizing and capturing it. Can be set per website.

field.comment: Display order of PayPal Billing Agreement among payment methods at checkout.
field.modal: Sets the position of the **PayPal Billing Agreement** method relative to other payment methods at checkout; lower values appear first. Can be set per website and per store view.

field.comment: Countries whose buyers may use the PayPal billing agreement method.
field.modal: Restricts the PayPal billing agreement method to buyers from the selected countries. Applies only when payment is limited to specific countries.

field.comment: Checkout method name shown to customers for PayPal Billing Agreement.
field.modal: The label displayed to customers for the PayPal Billing Agreement payment method at checkout. Can differ per store view.

field.comment: Whether SSL/TLS peer verification is enforced on Billing Agreement API connections.
field.modal: When **Yes**, the SSL certificate of PayPal's endpoint is verified on Billing Agreement API connections; when **No**, verification is skipped. Can be set per website.

field.comment: Brazil installment period shown on the PayPal button on the cart page.
field.modal: Selects the Brazil installment period displayed on the PayPal Smart Button when the cart-page button label is set to installment. The option list is PayPal-specific. Can be set per store view.

field.comment: Color of the customized PayPal Credit button on the cart page.
field.modal: Selects the color of the PayPal button on the cart page. Applies only when button customization is enabled and the button label is set to Credit. Can be set per website or store view.

field.comment: Whether the PayPal smart button on the cart page uses custom styling.
field.modal: When **Yes**, the PayPal button on the **Cart Page** uses the custom appearance settings; when **No**, it uses PayPal's defaults. Can be set per website and per store view.

field.comment: Visual layout of the PayPal checkout button on the cart page.
field.modal: Chooses the layout style of the PayPal smart button on the shopping cart page. Applies only when button customization is enabled for the cart page, and can be set per store view.

field.comment: Installment period shown on the Mexico PayPal installments button on the cart page.
field.modal: Selects the installment period offered for the Mexico-specific PayPal installments button on the cart page. Applies only when the cart-page button is customized with the installment label. Can differ per store view.

field.comment: Shape of the PayPal smart button on the cart page.
field.modal: Chooses the shape of the PayPal smart payment button shown on the cart page, from PayPal's available button shapes. Applies only when button customization is enabled for the checkout and cart pages. Can be set per website or store view.

field.comment: Installment period shown on the Brazil installment PayPal button at checkout.

field.comment: Color of the PayPal smart button on the checkout page.
field.modal: Chooses the color of the PayPal button shown on the **Checkout Page**, from the available button colors. Applies only when button customization is enabled for that location. Can be set per website and per store view.

field.comment: Whether to customize the PayPal button's appearance on the checkout page.
field.modal: When **Yes**, you can override the default style of the PayPal button on the checkout page; **No** keeps the defaults. Can be set per store view.

field.comment: Layout of the PayPal Credit smart button on the checkout page.
field.modal: Chooses the layout of the PayPal Credit smart button shown on the checkout page. Applies only when the checkout-page button is customized with the credit label. Can differ per store view.

field.comment: Installment period shown on the PayPal button for Mexico on the checkout page.
field.modal: Sets the Mexico installment period presented on the checkout-page PayPal smart button, from PayPal's available periods. Applies only when button customization is enabled and the button label is set to the installment option. Can be set per website or store view.

field.comment: Corner shape of the PayPal Smart Payment Button on the checkout page.
field.modal: Sets the shape of the PayPal **Smart Button** rendered on the checkout page. Applies only when checkout-page button customization is enabled. Can be set per store view.

field.comment: Installment period shown on the Brazil installment PayPal button in the mini cart.
field.modal: Selects the installment period for the Brazil installment button in the mini cart. Applies only when button customization is enabled and the button label is set to Installment. Can be set per website or store view.

field.comment: Color of the PayPal smart button in the mini cart.
field.modal: Chooses the color of the PayPal button shown in the **Mini Cart**, from the available button colors. Applies only when button customization is enabled for that location. Can be set per website and per store view.

field.comment: Whether to customize the PayPal button's appearance in the mini cart.
field.modal: When **Yes**, you can override the default style of the PayPal button in the mini cart; **No** keeps the defaults. Can be set per store view.

field.comment: Layout of the PayPal Credit smart button in the mini cart.
field.modal: Chooses the layout of the PayPal Credit smart button shown in the mini cart. Applies only when the mini-cart button is customized with the credit label. Can differ per store view.

field.comment: Installment period shown on the PayPal button for Mexico in the mini cart.
field.modal: Sets the Mexico installment period presented on the mini-cart PayPal smart button, from PayPal's available periods. Applies only when button customization is enabled and the button label is set to the installment option. Can be set per website or store view.

field.comment: Corner shape of the PayPal Smart Payment Button in the mini cart.
field.modal: Sets the shape of the PayPal **Smart Button** rendered in the mini cart. Applies only when checkout-page and mini-cart button customization are enabled. Can be set per store view.

field.comment: Name of a custom PayPal-hosted payment page style to apply.
field.modal: The name of a custom payment page layout (page style) configured in the merchant's PayPal account, applied to the PayPal-hosted pages shown during checkout. Can be set per website or store view.

field.comment: Background color of the header area on PayPal-hosted checkout pages.
field.modal: Sets the header background color shown on PayPal-hosted pages during checkout, part of the **Frontend Experience Settings**. Can be set per website and per store view.

field.comment: Color of the header border shown on PayPal-hosted pages.
field.modal: Sets the color used for the border of the header area on PayPal-hosted checkout pages. Can be set per store view.

field.comment: URL of the image shown in the header of PayPal-hosted checkout pages.
field.modal: The image URL displayed at the top of the PayPal-hosted pages customers see during checkout. Can differ per store view.

field.comment: Installment period shown on the Brazil installment PayPal button on product pages.
field.modal: Selects the installment period for the Brazil installment button on product pages. Applies only when button customization is enabled and the button label is set to Installment. Can be set per website or store view.

field.comment: Color of the PayPal smart button on product detail pages.
field.modal: Chooses the color of the PayPal button shown on **Product Pages**, from the available button colors. Applies only when button customization is enabled for that location. Can be set per website and per store view.

field.comment: Whether to customize the PayPal button's appearance on product pages.
field.modal: When **Yes**, you can override the default style of the PayPal button on product pages; **No** keeps the defaults. Can be set per store view.

field.comment: Layout of the PayPal Credit smart button on product pages.
field.modal: Chooses the layout of the PayPal Credit smart button shown on product pages. Applies only when the product-page button is customized with the credit label. Can differ per store view.

field.comment: Installment period shown on the PayPal button for Mexico on product pages.

field.comment: Corner shape of the PayPal Smart Payment Button on product pages.
field.modal: Sets the shape of the PayPal **Smart Button** rendered on product pages. Applies only when checkout-page and product-page button customization are enabled. Can be set per store view.

field.comment: Whether PayPal settlement reports are fetched automatically on a schedule.
field.modal: When **Yes**, settlement reports are retrieved from PayPal automatically on a schedule; **No** requires fetching them manually.

field.comment: Username used to sign in to the server where PayPal settlement reports are fetched.
field.modal: The login used to authenticate to the (S)FTP server from which settlement reports are downloaded. Stored encrypted. Can be set per website.

field.comment: The SFTP password used to fetch PayPal settlement reports.
field.modal: The password for the SFTP account PayPal uses to deliver settlement reports. Stored encrypted. Can be set per website.

field.comment: Whether settlement reports are fetched from PayPal's sandbox server instead of the live one.
field.modal: When **Yes**, PayPal settlement reports are retrieved from the **sandbox** (test) SFTP server rather than the production server. Can be set per website.

field.comment: Time of day when the PayPal settlement report is fetched.
field.modal: Sets the time of day at which Magento retrieves the settlement report from PayPal, part of **Settlement Report Settings**.

field.comment: Whether individual cart line items are sent to PayPal with the order.
field.modal: When **Yes**, each cart line item is transferred to PayPal so the itemized breakdown appears on the PayPal side; when **No**, only the order total is sent. Can be set per website.

field.comment: Whether the order review step is skipped after returning from PayPal.
field.modal: When **Yes**, the order is placed immediately after PayPal instead of showing the order review page; **No** keeps the review step.

field.comment: Countries PayPal Express Checkout is offered to when limited to specific countries.
field.modal: Selects which countries can use PayPal Express Checkout. Applies only when Payment Applicable From is set to specific countries. Can be set per website.

field.comment: Whether SSL/TLS peer verification is enforced on Express Checkout API connections.
field.modal: When **Yes**, the SSL certificate of PayPal's endpoint is verified on Express Checkout API connections; when **No**, verification is skipped. Can be set per website.

field.comment: Display order of PayPal Express Checkout among payment methods at checkout.
field.modal: Sets the position of PayPal Express Checkout in the list of payment methods at checkout (lower numbers appear first). Can be set per store view.

field.comment: Whether the PayPal Express Checkout button appears on product detail pages.
field.modal: **Yes** shows the PayPal Express Checkout button on product detail pages; **No** hides it. Can be set per website or store view.

field.comment: Enables or disables the PayPal Pay Later experience.

field.comment: Placement of the PayPal Pay Later (BML) banner on catalog category pages.

field.comment: Size of the PayPal Credit (Bill Me Later) banner shown on catalog category pages.

field.comment: Size of the PayPal Credit (Bill Me Later) banner shown on catalog category pages.

field.comment: Placement of the PayPal Credit (BML) banner on the checkout shopping cart page.

field.comment: Display size of the PayPal Credit (BML) banner on the shopping cart page.

field.comment: Display size of the PayPal Credit (BML) banner on the shopping cart page.
field.modal: Sets the size of the PayPal Credit / Banner-based-lending promo banner shown on the **Checkout Cart Page**. Applies only when the cart-page banner's **Position** is set to the matching layout option. Can be set per website.

field.comment: Whether the PayPal Pay Later banner is shown on the storefront home page.

field.comment: Placement of the PayPal Pay Later (BML) banner on the storefront home page.

field.comment: Size of the PayPal Credit (Bill Me Later) banner shown on the home page.
field.modal: Chooses the display size of the PayPal Credit / Bill Me Later promotional banner on the **Home Page**, from the available banner sizes. Applies only for the configured home-page banner position, and can be set per website.

field.comment: Size of the PayPal Credit (Bill Me Later) banner shown on the home page.
field.modal: Chooses the display size of the PayPal Credit / Bill Me Later promotional banner on the **Home Page**, from the available banner sizes. Applies only for the configured home-page banner position, and can be set per website.

field.comment: Shows the PayPal Bill Me Later promotional banner on catalog product pages.

field.comment: Display size of the PayPal Credit (BML) banner on the product page.

field.comment: Turns PayPal Pay Later promotional banners on or off across the storefront.

field.comment: Layout style of the PayPal Pay Later banner on the shopping cart page.
field.modal: Selects the layout style of the **Pay Later** banner on the cart page. Applies only when the cart-page Pay Later banner is displayed. Can be set per website.

field.comment: Text color of the PayPal Pay Later message on the cart page.
field.modal: Selects the text color of the PayPal Pay Later message on the **Checkout Cart Page**, from the available color options. Applies only when the cart-page Pay Later message is enabled and its style layout is set to Text. Can be set per website.

field.comment: Text size of the PayPal Pay Later banner on the cart page.
field.modal: Sets the size of the message text in the Pay Later banner on the shopping cart page. Applies only when the cart-page Pay Later banner is displayed with a text style layout.

field.comment: Color scheme for the PayPal Pay Later message on catalog category pages.
field.modal: Selects the color scheme of the PayPal Pay Later banner shown on catalog category pages. Applies only when the category-page Pay Later message is displayed and its style layout is set to flex. Can be set per website.

field.comment: Whether the PayPal Pay Later banner is shown on category pages.

field.comment: Layout style of the PayPal Pay Later message on catalog category pages.

field.comment: Text color of the Pay Later banner on category pages.

field.comment: Text size of the PayPal Pay Later text banner on the category page.
field.modal: Sets the text size of the **text**-layout PayPal Pay Later banner on the category page. Applies only when that banner is displayed with a text style layout. Can be set per website.

field.comment: Placement of the logo within the PayPal Pay Later banner at the checkout payment step.

field.comment: Logo variant for the PayPal Pay Later message on the checkout payment step.

field.modal: Chooses the aspect ratio/size of the **flex**-layout PayPal Pay Later banner on the checkout payment step. Applies only when that banner is displayed and its style layout is **flex**. Can be set per website.

field.comment: Layout style of the PayPal Pay Later banner on the checkout payment step.
field.modal: Selects the layout style of the **Pay Later** banner on the checkout payment step. Applies only when that banner is displayed. Can be set per website.

field.comment: Text color of the PayPal Pay Later message at the checkout payment step.

field.comment: Text size of the PayPal Pay Later banner at the checkout payment step.

field.comment: Logo style of the PayPal Pay Later banner on the storefront home page.
field.modal: Selects the logo style of the **Pay Later** banner on the home page. Applies only when the home-page Pay Later banner is displayed and its style layout is set to text. Can be set per website.

field.comment: Placement of the PayPal Pay Later message on the home page.

field.comment: Aspect ratio of the PayPal Pay Later banner on the home page.

field.comment: Enables the PayPal Payments Pro Hosted Solution payment method.
field.modal: Turns the PayPal Payments Pro Hosted Solution on or off (Yes/No). Can be set per website.

field.comment: The method used to authenticate Magento's calls to the PayPal API.
field.modal: Selects how the store authenticates to PayPal's API for Express Checkout (for example, by the type of API credential used). Can be set per website.

field.comment: API certificate file used to authenticate the store's PayPal account for Express Checkout.
field.modal: Uploads the PayPal API certificate that identifies and authenticates the merchant's PayPal account for **Express Checkout** API calls. Used instead of API signature credentials when certificate authentication is selected. Can be set per website.

field.comment: Password that authenticates Express Checkout API calls to the merchant's PayPal account.
field.modal: The API password used to authenticate Express Checkout API requests against the merchant's PayPal account. Stored encrypted, and can differ per website.

field.comment: API signature credential used to authenticate the store with your PayPal account.
field.modal: The PayPal API signature that authenticates requests from the store to your PayPal account. Stored encrypted. Applies when API signature authentication is in use. Can be set per website.

field.comment: The PayPal API username that identifies the merchant's account for Express Checkout.
field.modal: The API username used to identify and authenticate the merchant's PayPal account for Express Checkout API calls. Stored encrypted. Can be set per website.

field.comment: Country used to simulate the buyer's location when testing Express Checkout in sandbox mode.
field.modal: Selects a buyer country, from the country list, to emulate during **sandbox** testing of PayPal Express Checkout. Applies only when sandbox mode is enabled. Can be set per website.

field.comment: Hostname or IP of the proxy server used for PayPal API calls.
field.modal: The proxy host that PayPal API requests are routed through. Applies only when **Use Proxy** is enabled. Can be set per website.

field.comment: Whether Express Checkout runs against the PayPal sandbox instead of the live environment.
field.modal: When **Yes**, Express Checkout uses the PayPal sandbox for testing; when **No**, it processes live transactions. Can be set per website.

field.comment: Whether PayPal API calls are routed through a proxy server.
field.modal: When **Yes**, Express Checkout API requests are sent through a proxy host; **No** connects to PayPal directly.

field.comment: Whether the Express Checkout button appears in the Payment Information step.
field.modal: When **Yes**, the PayPal Express Checkout button is shown during the Payment Information step of checkout; when **No**, it is hidden. Can be set per website.

field.comment: Whether the payment is only authorized, or authorized and captured, when the order is placed.
field.modal: Chooses how funds are handled for PayPal Payments Pro Hosted Solution orders — typically **Authorization** (hold funds for later capture) or **Sale** (authorize and capture immediately). Can be set per website.

field.comment: Whether this method is offered in all allowed countries or only specific ones.
field.modal: Chooses whether PayPal Payments Pro Hosted Solution is available from **All Allowed Countries** or only from **Specific Countries**. Can be set per website.

field.comment: Whether Payments Pro Hosted Solution API calls are logged for debugging.
field.modal: When **Yes**, requests and responses exchanged with PayPal for the Hosted Pro method are written to the debug log. Can be set per website.

field.comment: Whether PayPal settlement reports are fetched automatically on a schedule.
field.modal: When **Yes**, settlement reports are retrieved from PayPal automatically on a schedule; **No** requires fetching them manually.

field.comment: Username used to sign in to the server where PayPal settlement reports are fetched.
field.modal: The login used to authenticate to the (S)FTP server from which settlement reports are downloaded. Stored encrypted. Can be set per website.

field.comment: The SFTP password used to fetch PayPal settlement reports.
field.modal: The password for the SFTP account PayPal uses to deliver settlement reports. Stored encrypted. Can be set per website.

field.comment: Whether settlement reports are fetched from PayPal's sandbox server instead of the live one.
field.modal: When **Yes**, PayPal settlement reports are retrieved from the **sandbox** (test) SFTP server rather than the production server. Can be set per website.

field.comment: Time of day when the PayPal settlement report is fetched.
field.modal: Sets the time of day at which Magento retrieves the settlement report from PayPal, part of **Settlement Report Settings**.

field.comment: The countries from which this payment method may be used.
field.modal: Selects the countries allowed to use this payment method. Applies only when payment is restricted to specific countries. Can be set per website.

field.comment: Whether PayPal's SSL certificate is verified on gateway API calls.
field.modal: When **Yes**, the SSL/TLS certificate of PayPal's endpoint is verified when the gateway connects (recommended). Can be set per website.

field.comment: Display order of this method relative to other payment methods at checkout.
field.modal: The position of PayPal Payments Pro Hosted Solution in the list of payment methods at checkout; lower numbers appear first. Can be set per website or store view.

field.comment: Whether the PayPal Pay Later banner is shown on the storefront category page.

field.comment: Size of the PayPal Credit (Bill Me Later) banner shown on catalog category pages.
field.modal: Chooses the display size of the PayPal Credit / Bill Me Later promotional banner on the **Catalog Category Page**, from the available banner sizes. Applies only for the configured category-page banner position, and can be set per website.

field.comment: Size of the PayPal Credit (Bill Me Later) banner shown on catalog category pages.
field.modal: Chooses the display size of the PayPal Credit / Bill Me Later promotional banner on the **Catalog Category Page**, from the available banner sizes. Applies only for the configured category-page banner position, and can be set per website.

field.comment: Shows the PayPal Bill Me Later promotional banner on the shopping cart page.
field.modal: When **Yes**, the PayPal Bill Me Later (PayPal Credit) banner appears on the shopping cart page; **No** hides it.

field.comment: Placement of the PayPal Credit (BML) banner on the checkout shopping cart page.
field.modal: Chooses where the PayPal Credit (Pay Later/BML) advertising banner appears on the checkout cart page. The available placements come from PayPal's banner position options. Can be set per website.

field.comment: Display size of the PayPal Credit (BML) banner on the shopping cart page.
field.modal: Sets the size of the PayPal Credit / Banner-based-lending promo banner shown on the **Checkout Cart Page**. Applies only when the cart-page banner's **Position** is set to the matching layout option. Can be set per website.

field.comment: Display size of the PayPal Credit (BML) banner on the shopping cart page.
field.modal: Sets the size of the PayPal Credit / Banner-based-lending promo banner shown on the **Checkout Cart Page**. Applies only when the cart-page banner's **Position** is set to the matching layout option. Can be set per website.

field.comment: Whether the PayPal Pay Later banner is shown on the storefront home page.
field.modal: Turns the **PayPal Pay Later** (Bill Me Later) promotional banner on or off on the **home** page. Can be set per website.

field.comment: Placement of the PayPal Pay Later (BML) banner on the storefront home page.
field.modal: Chooses where the **Pay Later / Bill Me Later** promotional banner appears on the home page. Can be set per website.

field.comment: Size of the PayPal Credit (Bill Me Later) banner shown on the home page.
field.modal: Chooses the display size of the PayPal Credit / Bill Me Later promotional banner on the **Home Page**, from the available banner sizes. Applies only for the configured home-page banner position, and can be set per website.

field.comment: Size of the PayPal Credit (Bill Me Later) banner shown on the home page.
field.modal: Chooses the display size of the PayPal Credit / Bill Me Later promotional banner on the **Home Page**, from the available banner sizes. Applies only for the configured home-page banner position, and can be set per website.

field.comment: Shows the PayPal Bill Me Later promotional banner on catalog product pages.
field.modal: When **Yes**, the PayPal Bill Me Later (PayPal Credit) banner appears on catalog product pages; **No** hides it.

field.comment: Placement of the PayPal Credit (BML) banner on the catalog product page.
field.modal: Chooses where the PayPal Credit (Pay Later/BML) advertising banner appears on product detail pages. Placements come from PayPal's banner position options. Can be set per website.

field.comment: Display size of the PayPal Credit (BML) banner on the product page.
field.modal: Sets the size of the PayPal Credit / Banner-based-lending promo banner shown on the **Catalog Product Page**. Applies only when the product-page banner's **Position** is set to the matching layout option. Can be set per website.

field.comment: Display size of the PayPal Credit (BML) banner on the product page.
field.modal: Sets the size of the PayPal Credit / Banner-based-lending promo banner shown on the **Catalog Product Page**. Applies only when the product-page banner's **Position** is set to the matching layout option. Can be set per website.

field.comment: Turns PayPal Pay Later promotional banners on or off across the storefront.
field.modal: Master switch for advertising **PayPal Pay Later** messaging. When **Yes**, the Pay Later banners configured for each page are eligible to show. Can be set per website.

field.comment: Color of the PayPal Pay Later banner on the shopping cart page.
field.modal: Selects the color variant of the **Pay Later** banner shown on the cart page. Applies only when the cart-page Pay Later banner is displayed and its style layout is set to flex. Can be set per website.

field.comment: Whether the PayPal Pay Later message is shown on the shopping cart page.
field.modal: When **Yes**, the PayPal Pay Later promotional message appears on the **Checkout Cart Page**; when **No**, it is hidden. Can be set per website.

field.comment: Placement of the logo within the PayPal Pay Later banner on the cart page.
field.modal: Sets where the logo sits inside the Pay Later messaging banner on the shopping cart page. Applies only when the cart-page Pay Later banner is displayed with a text style layout.

field.comment: Logo variant for the PayPal Pay Later message on the shopping cart page.
field.modal: Selects which PayPal Pay Later logo style is shown in the cart-page message. Applies only when the cart-page Pay Later message is displayed and its style layout is set to text. Can be set per website.

field.comment: Where the PayPal Pay Later banner is placed on the shopping cart page.
field.modal: Chooses the placement of the Pay Later banner on the **Checkout Cart Page** from the available positions. Applies only when the cart-page Pay Later banner **Display** is enabled. Can be set per website.

field.comment: Aspect ratio of the flex-layout PayPal Pay Later banner on the shopping cart page.
field.modal: Chooses the aspect ratio/size of the **flex**-layout PayPal Pay Later banner on the cart page. Applies only when that banner is displayed and its style layout is **flex**. Can be set per website.

field.comment: Layout style of the PayPal Pay Later banner on the shopping cart page.
field.modal: Selects the layout style of the **Pay Later** banner on the cart page. Applies only when the cart-page Pay Later banner is displayed. Can be set per website.

field.comment: Text color of the PayPal Pay Later message on the cart page.
field.modal: Selects the text color of the PayPal Pay Later message on the **Checkout Cart Page**, from the available color options. Applies only when the cart-page Pay Later message is enabled and its style layout is set to Text. Can be set per website.

field.comment: Text size of the PayPal Pay Later banner on the cart page.
field.modal: Sets the size of the message text in the Pay Later banner on the shopping cart page. Applies only when the cart-page Pay Later banner is displayed with a text style layout.

field.comment: Color scheme for the PayPal Pay Later message on catalog category pages.
field.modal: Selects the color scheme of the PayPal Pay Later banner shown on catalog category pages. Applies only when the category-page Pay Later message is displayed and its style layout is set to flex. Can be set per website.

field.comment: Whether the PayPal Pay Later banner is shown on category pages.
field.modal: When **Yes**, the PayPal Pay Later promotional banner appears on the **Catalog Category Page**; when **No**, it is hidden. Can be set per website.

field.comment: Position of the PayPal logo within the Pay Later text banner on the category page.
field.modal: Where the PayPal logo sits within the **text**-layout Pay Later banner on the category page. Applies only when that banner is displayed with a text style layout and a primary/alternative logo type. Can be set per website.

field.comment: Logo style of the PayPal Pay Later banner on catalog category pages.
field.modal: Selects the logo style of the **Pay Later** banner on category pages. Applies only when the category-page Pay Later banner is displayed and its style layout is set to text. Can be set per website.

field.comment: Placement of the PayPal Pay Later message on catalog category pages.
field.modal: Chooses where the PayPal Pay Later message is placed on the **Catalog Category Page**, from the available positions. Applies only when the category-page Pay Later message is enabled. Can be set per website.

field.comment: Aspect ratio of the PayPal Pay Later banner on category pages.
field.modal: Sets the shape/aspect ratio of the Pay Later banner on catalog category pages. Applies only when the category-page Pay Later banner is displayed with a flex style layout.

field.comment: Layout style of the PayPal Pay Later message on catalog category pages.
field.modal: Chooses the layout format of the PayPal Pay Later banner on catalog category pages, which in turn determines whether a logo-type or color option applies. Applies only when the category-page Pay Later message is displayed. Can be set per website.

field.comment: Text color of the Pay Later banner on category pages.
field.modal: Selects the text color for the Pay Later banner on the **Catalog Category Page** from PayPal's allowed color options. Applies only when the category-page banner **Display** is enabled and its style layout is **Text**. Can be set per website.

field.comment: Text size of the PayPal Pay Later text banner on the category page.
field.modal: Sets the text size of the **text**-layout PayPal Pay Later banner on the category page. Applies only when that banner is displayed with a text style layout. Can be set per website.

field.comment: Color of the PayPal Pay Later banner on the checkout payment step.
field.modal: Selects the color variant of the **Pay Later** banner shown on the checkout payment step. Applies only when that banner is displayed and its style layout is set to flex. Can be set per website.

field.comment: Whether the PayPal Pay Later message is shown at the checkout payment step.
field.modal: When **Yes**, the PayPal Pay Later promotional message appears at the **Checkout Payment Step**; when **No**, it is hidden. Can be set per website.

field.comment: Placement of the logo within the PayPal Pay Later banner at the checkout payment step.
field.modal: Sets where the logo sits inside the Pay Later banner on the checkout payment step. Applies only when that Pay Later banner is displayed with a text style layout.

field.comment: Logo variant for the PayPal Pay Later message on the checkout payment step.
field.modal: Selects which PayPal Pay Later logo style is shown during the checkout payment step. Applies only when that Pay Later message is displayed and its style layout is set to text. Can be set per website.

field.comment: Where the PayPal Pay Later banner is placed at the checkout payment step.
field.modal: Chooses the placement of the Pay Later banner on the **Checkout Payment Step** from the available positions. Applies only when the payment-step Pay Later banner **Display** is enabled. Can be set per website.

field.comment: Aspect ratio of the flex-layout PayPal Pay Later banner on the checkout payment step.
field.modal: Chooses the aspect ratio/size of the **flex**-layout PayPal Pay Later banner on the checkout payment step. Applies only when that banner is displayed and its style layout is **flex**. Can be set per website.

field.comment: Layout style of the PayPal Pay Later banner on the checkout payment step.
field.modal: Selects the layout style of the **Pay Later** banner on the checkout payment step. Applies only when that banner is displayed. Can be set per website.

field.comment: Text color of the PayPal Pay Later message at the checkout payment step.
field.modal: Selects the text color of the PayPal Pay Later message at the **Checkout Payment Step**, from the available color options. Applies only when that message is enabled and its style layout is set to Text. Can be set per website.

field.comment: Text size of the PayPal Pay Later banner at the checkout payment step.
field.modal: Sets the size of the message text in the Pay Later banner on the checkout payment step. Applies only when that Pay Later banner is displayed with a text style layout.

field.comment: Color scheme for the PayPal Pay Later message on the home page.
field.modal: Selects the color scheme of the PayPal Pay Later banner shown on the storefront home page. Applies only when the home-page Pay Later message is displayed and its style layout is set to flex. Can be set per website.

field.comment: Whether the PayPal Pay Later banner is shown on the home page.
field.modal: When **Yes**, the PayPal Pay Later promotional banner appears on the **Home Page**; when **No**, it is hidden. Can be set per website.

field.comment: Position of the PayPal logo within the Pay Later text banner on the home page.
field.modal: Where the PayPal logo sits within the **text**-layout Pay Later banner on the home page. Applies only when that banner is displayed with a text style layout and a primary/alternative logo type. Can be set per website.

field.comment: Logo style of the PayPal Pay Later banner on the storefront home page.
field.modal: Selects the logo style of the **Pay Later** banner on the home page. Applies only when the home-page Pay Later banner is displayed and its style layout is set to text. Can be set per website.

field.comment: Placement of the PayPal Pay Later message on the home page.
field.modal: Chooses where the PayPal Pay Later message is placed on the **Home Page**, from the available positions. Applies only when the home-page Pay Later message is enabled. Can be set per website.

field.comment: Aspect ratio of the PayPal Pay Later banner on the home page.
field.modal: Sets the shape/aspect ratio of the Pay Later banner on the home page. Applies only when the home-page Pay Later banner is displayed with a flex style layout.

field.comment: Layout style of the PayPal Pay Later message on the home page.
field.modal: Chooses the layout format of the PayPal Pay Later banner on the home page. Applies only when the home-page Pay Later message is displayed. Can be set per website.

field.comment: Text color of the Pay Later banner on the home page.
field.modal: Selects the text color for the Pay Later banner on the **Home Page** from PayPal's allowed color options. Applies only when the home-page banner **Display** is enabled and its style layout is **Text**. Can be set per website.

field.comment: Text size of the PayPal Pay Later text banner on the home page.
field.modal: Sets the text size of the **text**-layout PayPal Pay Later banner on the home page. Applies only when that banner is displayed with a text style layout. Can be set per website.

field.comment: Color of the PayPal Pay Later banner on product detail pages.
field.modal: Selects the color variant of the **Pay Later** banner shown on product pages. Applies only when that banner is displayed and its style layout is set to flex. Can be set per website.

field.comment: Whether the PayPal Pay Later message is shown on product detail pages.
field.modal: When **Yes**, the PayPal Pay Later promotional message appears on the **Catalog Product Page**; when **No**, it is hidden. Can be set per website.

field.comment: Placement of the logo within the PayPal Pay Later banner on product pages.
field.modal: Sets where the logo sits inside the Pay Later banner on catalog product pages. Applies only when the product-page Pay Later banner is displayed with a text style layout.

field.comment: Logo variant for the PayPal Pay Later message on product pages.
field.modal: Selects which PayPal Pay Later logo style is shown in the product-page message. Applies only when the product-page Pay Later message is displayed and its style layout is set to text. Can be set per website.

field.comment: Where the PayPal Pay Later banner is placed on product pages.
field.modal: Chooses the placement of the Pay Later banner on the **Catalog Product Page** from the available positions. Applies only when the product-page Pay Later banner **Display** is enabled. Can be set per website.

field.comment: Aspect ratio of the flex-layout PayPal Pay Later banner on the product page.
field.modal: Chooses the aspect ratio/size of the **flex**-layout PayPal Pay Later banner on the catalog product page. Applies only when that banner is displayed and its style layout is **flex**. Can be set per website.

field.comment: Layout style of the PayPal Pay Later banner on product detail pages.
field.modal: Selects the layout style of the **Pay Later** banner on product pages. Applies only when the product-page Pay Later banner is displayed. Can be set per website.

field.comment: Text color of the PayPal Pay Later message on product detail pages.
field.modal: Selects the text color of the PayPal Pay Later message on the **Catalog Product Page**, from the available color options. Applies only when the product-page message is enabled and its style layout is set to Text. Can be set per website.

field.comment: Text size of the PayPal Pay Later banner on product pages.
field.modal: Sets the size of the message text in the Pay Later banner on catalog product pages. Applies only when the product-page Pay Later banner is displayed with a text style layout.

field.comment: Enables or disables this PayPal payment solution.
field.modal: When **Yes**, this PayPal solution is active and available at checkout; when **No**, it is turned off. Can be set per website.

field.comment: Enables or disables the PayPal Pay Later experience.
field.modal: Turns the PayPal Pay Later experience on or off for this PayPal solution. When **No**, Pay Later messaging and banners are not offered. Can be set per website.

field.comment: Display order of PayPal Credit relative to other payment methods at checkout.
field.modal: Sets the position of **PayPal Credit** among the available payment methods at checkout (lower numbers appear first). Applies only when Express Checkout PayPal Credit is enabled.

field.comment: The method used to authenticate Magento's calls to the PayPal API.
field.modal: Selects how the store authenticates to PayPal's API for Express Checkout (for example, by the type of API credential used). Can be set per website.

field.comment: API certificate file used to authenticate the store's PayPal account for Express Checkout.
field.modal: Uploads the PayPal API certificate that identifies and authenticates the merchant's PayPal account for **Express Checkout** API calls. Used instead of API signature credentials when certificate authentication is selected. Can be set per website.

field.comment: Password that authenticates Express Checkout API calls to the merchant's PayPal account.
field.modal: The API password used to authenticate Express Checkout API requests against the merchant's PayPal account. Stored encrypted, and can differ per website.

field.comment: API signature credential used to authenticate the store with your PayPal account.
field.modal: The PayPal API signature that authenticates requests from the store to your PayPal account. Stored encrypted. Applies when API signature authentication is in use. Can be set per website.

field.comment: The PayPal API username that identifies the merchant's account for Express Checkout.
field.modal: The API username used to identify and authenticate the merchant's PayPal account for Express Checkout API calls. Stored encrypted. Can be set per website.

field.comment: Country used to simulate the buyer's location when testing Express Checkout in sandbox mode.
field.modal: Selects a buyer country, from the country list, to emulate during **sandbox** testing of PayPal Express Checkout. Applies only when sandbox mode is enabled. Can be set per website.

field.comment: Hostname or IP of the proxy server used for PayPal API calls.
field.modal: The proxy host that PayPal API requests are routed through. Applies only when **Use Proxy** is enabled. Can be set per website.

field.comment: Whether Express Checkout runs against the PayPal sandbox instead of the live environment.
field.modal: When **Yes**, Express Checkout uses the PayPal sandbox for testing; when **No**, it processes live transactions. Can be set per website.

field.comment: Whether PayPal API calls are routed through a proxy server.
field.modal: When **Yes**, Express Checkout API requests are sent through a proxy host; **No** connects to PayPal directly.

field.comment: Merchant Account ID that identifies your PayPal account for In-Context Checkout.
field.modal: Your PayPal merchant account identifier, used to associate the store with your PayPal account. Applies only when In-Context Checkout is enabled. Can be set per website.

field.comment: The payment action used when an order is placed through PayPal Express Checkout.
field.modal: Selects how a PayPal Express Checkout order is processed at placement — the payment action applied to the transaction. Can be set per website.

field.comment: Whether PayPal Express Checkout applies to all allowed countries or only specific ones.
field.modal: Chooses whether PayPal Express Checkout is offered to **all allowed countries** or only to a **specific** list of countries (set in the related country field). Can be set per website.

field.comment: Visual style of the PayPal Express Checkout shortcut buttons.
field.modal: Selects the visual flavor of the PayPal shortcut (Express Checkout) buttons shown in the storefront. Can be set per website or store view.

field.comment: Whether PayPal Express Checkout API calls are logged for debugging.
field.modal: When **Yes**, requests and responses exchanged with PayPal for Express Checkout are written to the debug log. Can be set per website.

field.comment: Whether customers can create a PayPal billing agreement from their account.
field.modal: When **Yes**, customers can set up a PayPal billing agreement through the wizard in their account area; **No** disables it.

field.comment: Whether the PayPal Billing Agreement method is offered to all countries or only selected ones.
field.modal: Chooses whether PayPal Billing Agreement is available from all allowed countries or only a specific list. When restricted, the countries are chosen in a separate setting. Can be set per website.

field.comment: Logs PayPal API request and response data for Billing Agreement troubleshooting.
field.modal: When **Yes**, PayPal Billing Agreement API calls are logged to help with troubleshooting; when **No**, logging is off. Can be set per website.

field.comment: Whether individual cart line items are sent to PayPal for billing-agreement orders.
field.modal: When **Yes**, each cart line item (name, quantity, price) is transferred to PayPal rather than only the order total, for PayPal Billing Agreement transactions. Can be set per website.

field.comment: How PayPal processes payment for billing-agreement orders.
field.modal: Selects the payment action PayPal performs for billing-agreement orders — for example, authorizing the amount only, or authorizing and capturing it. Can be set per website.

field.comment: Display order of PayPal Billing Agreement among payment methods at checkout.
field.modal: Sets the position of the **PayPal Billing Agreement** method relative to other payment methods at checkout; lower values appear first. Can be set per website and per store view.

field.comment: Countries whose buyers may use the PayPal billing agreement method.
field.modal: Restricts the PayPal billing agreement method to buyers from the selected countries. Applies only when payment is limited to specific countries.

field.comment: Checkout method name shown to customers for PayPal Billing Agreement.
field.modal: The label displayed to customers for the PayPal Billing Agreement payment method at checkout. Can differ per store view.

field.comment: Whether SSL/TLS peer verification is enforced on Billing Agreement API connections.
field.modal: When **Yes**, the SSL certificate of PayPal's endpoint is verified on Billing Agreement API connections; when **No**, verification is skipped. Can be set per website.

field.comment: Brazil installment period shown on the PayPal button on the cart page.
field.modal: Selects the Brazil installment period displayed on the PayPal Smart Button when the cart-page button label is set to installment. The option list is PayPal-specific. Can be set per store view.

field.comment: Color of the customized PayPal Credit button on the cart page.
field.modal: Selects the color of the PayPal button on the cart page. Applies only when button customization is enabled and the button label is set to Credit. Can be set per website or store view.

field.comment: Whether the PayPal smart button on the cart page uses custom styling.
field.modal: When **Yes**, the PayPal button on the **Cart Page** uses the custom appearance settings; when **No**, it uses PayPal's defaults. Can be set per website and per store view.

field.comment: Visual layout of the PayPal checkout button on the cart page.
field.modal: Chooses the layout style of the PayPal smart button on the shopping cart page. Applies only when button customization is enabled for the cart page, and can be set per store view.
