field.modal: Selects the text color of the PayPal Pay Later message at the **Checkout Payment Step**, from the available color options. Applies only when that message is enabled and its style layout is set to Text. Can be set per website.

field.comment: Text size of the PayPal Pay Later banner at the checkout payment step.
field.modal: Sets the size of the message text in the Pay Later banner on the checkout payment step. Applies only when that Pay Later banner is displayed with a text style layout.

field.comment: Color scheme for the PayPal Pay Later message on the home page.
field.modal: Selects the color scheme of the PayPal Pay Later banner shown on the storefront home page. Applies only when the home-page Pay Later message is displayed and its style layout is set to flex. Can be set per website.

field.comment: Whether the PayPal Pay Later banner is shown on the home page.
field.modal: When **Yes**, the PayPal Pay Later promotional banner appears on the **Home Page**; when **No**, it is hidden. Can be set per website.

field.comment: Position of the PayPal logo within the Pay Later text banner on the home page.
field.modal: Where the PayPal logo sits within the **text**-layout Pay Later banner on the home page. Applies only when that banner is displayed with a text style layout and a primary/alternative logo type. Can be set per website.

field.comment: Logo style of the PayPal Pay Later banner on the storefront home page.
field.modal: Selects the logo style of the **Pay Later** banner on the home page. Applies only when the home-page Pay Later banner is displayed and its style layout is set to text. Can be set per website.

field.comment: Placement of the PayPal Pay Later message on the home page.
field.modal: Chooses where the PayPal Pay Later message is placed on the **Home Page**, from the available positions. Applies only when the home-page Pay Later message is enabled. Can be set per website.

field.comment: Aspect ratio of the PayPal Pay Later banner on the home page.
field.modal: Sets the shape/aspect ratio of the Pay Later banner on the home page. Applies only when the home-page Pay Later banner is displayed with a flex style layout.

field.comment: Layout style of the PayPal Pay Later message on the home page.
field.modal: Chooses the layout format of the PayPal Pay Later banner on the home page. Applies only when the home-page Pay Later message is displayed. Can be set per website.

field.comment: Text color of the Pay Later banner on the home page.
field.modal: Selects the text color for the Pay Later banner on the **Home Page** from PayPal's allowed color options. Applies only when the home-page banner **Display** is enabled and its style layout is **Text**. Can be set per website.

field.comment: Text size of the PayPal Pay Later text banner on the home page.
field.modal: Sets the text size of the **text**-layout PayPal Pay Later banner on the home page. Applies only when that banner is displayed with a text style layout. Can be set per website.

field.comment: Color of the PayPal Pay Later banner on product detail pages.
field.modal: Selects the color variant of the **Pay Later** banner shown on product pages. Applies only when that banner is displayed and its style layout is set to flex. Can be set per website.

field.comment: Whether the PayPal Pay Later message is shown on product detail pages.
field.modal: When **Yes**, the PayPal Pay Later promotional message appears on the **Catalog Product Page**; when **No**, it is hidden. Can be set per website.

field.comment: Placement of the logo within the PayPal Pay Later banner on product pages.
field.modal: Sets where the logo sits inside the Pay Later banner on catalog product pages. Applies only when the product-page Pay Later banner is displayed with a text style layout.

field.comment: Logo variant for the PayPal Pay Later message on product pages.
field.modal: Selects which PayPal Pay Later logo style is shown in the product-page message. Applies only when the product-page Pay Later message is displayed and its style layout is set to text. Can be set per website.

field.comment: Where the PayPal Pay Later banner is placed on product pages.
field.modal: Chooses the placement of the Pay Later banner on the **Catalog Product Page** from the available positions. Applies only when the product-page Pay Later banner **Display** is enabled. Can be set per website.

field.comment: Aspect ratio of the flex-layout PayPal Pay Later banner on the product page.
field.modal: Chooses the aspect ratio/size of the **flex**-layout PayPal Pay Later banner on the catalog product page. Applies only when that banner is displayed and its style layout is **flex**. Can be set per website.

field.comment: Layout style of the PayPal Pay Later banner on product detail pages.
field.modal: Selects the layout style of the **Pay Later** banner on product pages. Applies only when the product-page Pay Later banner is displayed. Can be set per website.

field.comment: Text color of the PayPal Pay Later message on product detail pages.
field.modal: Selects the text color of the PayPal Pay Later message on the **Catalog Product Page**, from the available color options. Applies only when the product-page message is enabled and its style layout is set to Text. Can be set per website.

field.comment: Text size of the PayPal Pay Later banner on product pages.
field.modal: Sets the size of the message text in the Pay Later banner on catalog product pages. Applies only when the product-page Pay Later banner is displayed with a text style layout.

field.comment: Buyer country used to simulate transactions while sandbox mode is on.
field.modal: A country selected from the directory country list, used to simulate the buyer's country for Payflow Pro testing. Applies only when **Sandbox Mode** is enabled. Can be set per website.

field.comment: The Payflow Partner ID that identifies your PayPal Payflow Pro account to the gateway.
field.modal: The **Partner** value supplied by PayPal or an authorized reseller that identifies the Payflow Pro account when connecting to the gateway. Can be set per website.

field.comment: Hostname or IP of the proxy server used for Payflow Pro API calls.
field.modal: The proxy host that Payflow Pro API requests are routed through. Applies only when **Use Proxy** is enabled. Can be set per website.

field.comment: Encrypted password that authenticates the store's PayPal Payflow Pro account.
field.modal: The password used to authenticate the merchant's **Payflow Pro** account with PayPal. Stored encrypted. Can be set per website.

field.comment: Runs Payflow Pro against the PayPal sandbox instead of live processing.
field.modal: When **Yes**, transactions use the PayPal sandbox (test) environment rather than live processing.

field.comment: Whether PayPal Payflow Pro connects to PayPal through a proxy server.
field.modal: Chooses whether requests to PayPal are routed through a proxy server (Yes/No). Can be set per website.

field.comment: The Payflow Pro user credential used to authenticate with the gateway.
field.modal: The user credential that identifies and authenticates the merchant's PayPal Payflow Pro account. Stored encrypted. Can be set per website.

field.comment: The Payflow Vendor (merchant login) that identifies your PayPal Payflow Pro account.
field.modal: The **Vendor** value — your merchant login created with PayPal — used to authenticate Payflow Pro gateway requests. Can be set per website.

field.comment: Checkout label shown for saved (vaulted) Payflow Pro cards.
field.modal: The method title displayed to customers for stored Payflow Pro cards (card vault) at checkout. Can be set per website.

field.comment: Whether the order amount is authorized only, or authorized and captured, at checkout.
field.modal: Chooses how Payflow Pro processes the payment when an order is placed, such as authorizing the amount only or authorizing and capturing it. Uses PayPal's payment-action options.

field.comment: Whether PayPal Payflow Pro is offered to all countries or only selected ones.
field.modal: Chooses whether the method is available from all allowed countries or only a specific list. When restricted, the countries are chosen in a separate setting. Can be set per website.

field.comment: Logs PayPal Payflow Pro API request and response data for troubleshooting.
field.modal: When **Yes**, Payflow Pro API calls are logged to help with troubleshooting; when **No**, logging is off. Can be set per website.

field.comment: Whether to reject the transaction when the card issuer is located outside the United States.
field.modal: Part of the AVS fraud checks: when **Yes**, a transaction is rejected if the card's issuing bank is outside the United States. Can be set per website.

field.comment: How a transaction is treated when the card security code (CVV) does not match.
field.modal: Part of **CVV and AVS Settings** — controls how Payflow Pro handles a transaction when the card security code does not match (**Yes** / **No**). Can be set per website.

field.comment: Whether a Payflow Pro AVS street-address mismatch is treated as a failed check.
field.modal: When **Yes**, a transaction where the Address Verification Service reports the street address does not match is treated as a failed address check. Part of the **CVV and AVS Settings**. Can be set per website.

field.comment: Whether to reject a transaction when the AVS ZIP check does not match.
field.modal: When **Yes**, a transaction is rejected if the card's AVS ZIP/postal-code check does not match; **No** allows it through.

field.comment: Name of a custom PayPal-hosted payment page style to apply.
field.modal: The name of a custom payment page layout (page style) configured in the merchant's PayPal account, applied to the PayPal-hosted pages shown during checkout. Can be set per website or store view.

field.comment: Background color of the header area on PayPal-hosted checkout pages.
field.modal: Sets the header background color shown on PayPal-hosted pages during checkout, part of the **Frontend Experience Settings**. Can be set per website and per store view.

field.comment: Color of the header border shown on PayPal-hosted pages.
field.modal: Sets the color used for the border of the header area on PayPal-hosted checkout pages. Can be set per store view.

field.comment: URL of the image shown in the header of PayPal-hosted checkout pages.
field.modal: The image URL displayed at the top of the PayPal-hosted pages customers see during checkout. Can differ per store view.

field.comment: Whether PayPal settlement reports are fetched automatically on a schedule.
field.modal: When **Yes**, settlement reports are retrieved from PayPal automatically on a schedule; **No** requires fetching them manually.

field.comment: Username used to sign in to the server where PayPal settlement reports are fetched.
field.modal: The login used to authenticate to the (S)FTP server from which settlement reports are downloaded. Stored encrypted. Can be set per website.

field.comment: The SFTP password used to fetch PayPal settlement reports.
field.modal: The password for the SFTP account PayPal uses to deliver settlement reports. Stored encrypted. Can be set per website.

field.comment: Whether settlement reports are fetched from PayPal's sandbox server instead of the live one.
field.modal: When **Yes**, PayPal settlement reports are retrieved from the **sandbox** (test) SFTP server rather than the production server. Can be set per website.

field.comment: Time of day when the PayPal settlement report is fetched.
field.modal: Sets the time of day at which Magento retrieves the settlement report from PayPal, part of **Settlement Report Settings**.

field.comment: The countries this method is available from when restricted to specific countries.
field.modal: Selects which countries PayPal Payflow Pro is offered in. Applies only when **Payment Applicable From** is set to specific countries. Can be set per website.

field.comment: Whether customers must enter the card CVV for Payflow Pro payments.
field.modal: When **Yes**, the card security code (CVV) is required for Payflow Pro card payments; when **No**, it is not requested. Can be set per website.

field.comment: Whether SSL peer verification is applied to Payflow Pro API calls.
field.modal: When **Yes**, the SSL certificate of the Payflow API endpoint is verified on each call; **No** skips verification.

field.comment: Display order of PayPal Payflow Pro among the available payment methods.
field.modal: Sets the position of Payflow Pro relative to other payment methods; lower numbers appear first. Can differ per store view.

field.comment: Turns on the persistent shopping cart, which remembers a customer's session across visits.
field.modal: When **Yes**, Magento keeps a persistent session for returning customers so their cart and related data are remembered between visits. Can be set per website.

field.comment: How long, in seconds, the persistent session is kept.
field.modal: The lifetime of the persistent session, in seconds. Applies only when **Enable Persistence** is set to Yes. Can be set per website.

field.comment: Whether the persistent session is cleared when the customer signs out.
field.modal: When **Yes**, the persistent session is cleared when the customer signs out; when **No**, it persists after sign out. Applies only when **Enable Persistence** is Yes.

field.comment: Whether the Remember Me checkbox is ticked by default.
field.modal: Sets the default state of the **Remember Me** checkbox: **Yes** pre-ticks it, **No** leaves it unchecked. Applies only when **Enable Persistence** is Yes.

field.comment: Whether a Remember Me checkbox is shown on the login and registration forms.
field.modal: When **Yes**, a **Remember Me** checkbox is displayed on the login and registration forms, letting customers opt into a persistent session. Applies only when **Enable Persistence** is Yes.

field.comment: Whether the shopping cart contents are retained in the persistent session.
field.modal: When **Yes**, the contents of the shopping cart are kept as part of the persistent session between visits. Applies only when **Enable Persistence** is Yes.

field.comment: The character format used when coupon codes are auto-generated.
field.modal: Selects the format of automatically generated coupon codes, such as alphanumeric, alphabetical, or numeric character sets.

field.comment: Text added to the start of every auto-generated coupon code.
field.modal: An optional prefix prepended to each automatically generated coupon code, useful for grouping or branding codes.

field.comment: Text added to the end of every auto-generated coupon code.
field.modal: An optional suffix appended to each automatically generated coupon code.

field.comment: The message shown in the Admin when reCAPTCHA cannot be verified due to a technical error.
field.modal: The text displayed to an admin user when the reCAPTCHA service cannot be reached or verified, as opposed to a failed challenge. Shown for the Admin Panel reCAPTCHA.

field.comment: The message shown in the Admin when reCAPTCHA validation fails for a submitted form.
field.modal: The text displayed to an admin user when their reCAPTCHA check does not pass and the form is rejected. Shown for the Admin Panel reCAPTCHA.

field.comment: Selects which configured reCAPTCHA protects the admin forgot-password form.
field.modal: Chooses which configured reCAPTCHA type is required on the admin forgot-password form; leave unset to not protect it. The reCAPTCHA keys must be configured first.

field.comment: Selects which configured reCAPTCHA protects the Admin Panel login form.
field.modal: Chooses which configured reCAPTCHA type is required on the admin sign-in form; leave unset to not protect it. The reCAPTCHA keys must be configured first.

field.comment: Where the invisible reCAPTCHA badge is placed on admin forms.
field.modal: Selects the on-screen position of the reCAPTCHA v2 Invisible badge shown on protected admin forms.

field.comment: The Google reCAPTCHA v2 Invisible secret key used to verify admin responses.
field.modal: The private (secret) key issued by Google for reCAPTCHA v2 Invisible, used server-side to verify responses from protected admin forms. Stored encrypted.

field.comment: The Google reCAPTCHA v2 Invisible site key used on Admin Panel forms.
field.modal: The public (website) key issued by Google for reCAPTCHA v2 Invisible, used to render the widget on protected admin forms. Stored encrypted.

field.comment: The colour theme of the reCAPTCHA badge on admin forms.
field.modal: Selects the colour theme used for the reCAPTCHA v2 Invisible badge on protected admin forms.

field.comment: Google reCAPTCHA v2 secret key used to verify Admin reCAPTCHA responses server-side.
field.modal: The secret key issued by Google for reCAPTCHA v2, used server-side to validate checkbox responses on the **Admin** panel. Stored encrypted; keep it confidential.

field.comment: Google reCAPTCHA v2 site key for the Admin panel's "I am not a robot" widget.
field.modal: The public site key issued by Google for reCAPTCHA v2 ("I am not a robot"), used to render the checkbox widget on **Admin** forms. Stored encrypted.

field.comment: The display size of the Admin reCAPTCHA v2 checkbox widget.
field.modal: Sets the size of the reCAPTCHA v2 checkbox widget shown on the Admin panel, to suit the form layout.

field.comment: The colour theme of the Admin reCAPTCHA v2 checkbox widget.
field.modal: Sets the colour theme of the reCAPTCHA v2 checkbox widget on the Admin panel, to match the surrounding page.

field.comment: Where the reCAPTCHA v3 Invisible badge appears on admin forms.
field.modal: Sets the on-screen position of the invisible reCAPTCHA badge for admin (backend) forms.

field.comment: The Google reCAPTCHA v3 Invisible secret key used to validate admin (backend) forms.
field.modal: The secret key from your Google reCAPTCHA v3 Invisible registration, used server-side to validate responses on admin (backend) forms. Stored encrypted.

field.comment: The Google reCAPTCHA v3 Invisible site key used for admin (backend) forms.
field.modal: The public site key from your Google reCAPTCHA v3 Invisible registration, used to render reCAPTCHA on admin (backend) forms. Stored encrypted.

field.comment: The visual theme of the reCAPTCHA v3 Invisible badge on admin forms.
field.modal: Selects the visual theme of the invisible reCAPTCHA badge shown on admin (backend) forms.

field.comment: The message shown when reCAPTCHA cannot be verified due to a technical error.
field.modal: The text displayed on storefront forms when reCAPTCHA verification cannot complete for a technical reason (for example the service is unreachable), rather than because the shopper failed the check. Can differ per website or store view.

field.comment: The message shown to shoppers when reCAPTCHA validation rejects their submission.
field.modal: The text displayed on storefront forms when the reCAPTCHA check fails and the submission is treated as a bot. Can differ per website or store view, so the wording can be localised per store.

field.comment: Selects which configured reCAPTCHA protects the storefront Contact Us form.
field.modal: Chooses which configured reCAPTCHA type is required on the Contact Us form; leave unset to not protect it. The reCAPTCHA keys must be configured first. Can be set per website.

field.comment: Selects which configured reCAPTCHA protects the cart coupon-code form.
field.modal: Chooses which configured reCAPTCHA type is required when a shopper applies a coupon code; leave unset to not protect it. The reCAPTCHA keys must be configured first. Can be set per website.

field.comment: Which reCAPTCHA type protects the create-new-account form, or turns it off there.
field.modal: Selects the reCAPTCHA implementation applied to the storefront **create new customer account** form, chosen from the reCAPTCHA types configured on this store, or disables reCAPTCHA for that form. Can differ per website.

field.comment: Which reCAPTCHA type protects the edit-account form, or turns it off there.
field.modal: Selects the reCAPTCHA implementation applied to the storefront **edit customer account** form, chosen from the reCAPTCHA types configured on this store, or disables reCAPTCHA for that form. Can differ per website.

field.comment: Which reCAPTCHA type protects the storefront forgot-password form, or turns it off there.
field.modal: Selects the reCAPTCHA implementation applied to the storefront **forgot password** form, chosen from the reCAPTCHA types configured on this store, or disables reCAPTCHA for that form. Can differ per website.

field.comment: Which reCAPTCHA type protects the storefront customer login form, or turns it off there.
field.modal: Selects the reCAPTCHA implementation applied to the storefront customer **login** form, chosen from the reCAPTCHA types configured on this store, or disables reCAPTCHA for that form. Can differ per website.

field.comment: Which configured reCAPTCHA protects the PayPal Payflow Pro payment form, or none.
field.modal: Selects which of the reCAPTCHA types set up under the reCAPTCHA configuration guards the PayPal Payflow Pro payment form, or disables the check for it. Can differ per website.

field.comment: Which configured reCAPTCHA protects the checkout order placement step, or none.
field.modal: Selects which of the reCAPTCHA types set up under the reCAPTCHA configuration guards the checkout / place-order step, or disables the check for it. Can differ per website.

field.comment: Which reCAPTCHA type protects the storefront product review form.
field.modal: Selects the reCAPTCHA type applied to the product review form, or disables it. The available types are those configured in the storefront reCAPTCHA settings. Can differ per website.

field.comment: Which reCAPTCHA protects the storefront Resend Confirmation Email form, or none.
field.modal: Selects the reCAPTCHA type applied to the storefront **Resend Confirmation Email** form. The choices come from the reCAPTCHA types configured under the reCAPTCHA settings; leave unset to apply no reCAPTCHA here. Can differ per website.

field.comment: Which reCAPTCHA type protects the storefront Email to a Friend form.
field.modal: Selects the reCAPTCHA variant applied to the storefront **Send to Friend** form, chosen from the reCAPTCHA types configured for the frontend. Can be set per website.

field.comment: Selects which configured reCAPTCHA type protects the storefront wishlist sharing form.
field.modal: Chooses the reCAPTCHA type applied to the **Share Wish List** form on the storefront. Options are the reCAPTCHA integrations configured under the reCAPTCHA settings; leave unset to protect the form with no reCAPTCHA. Can differ per website.

field.comment: Where the invisible reCAPTCHA badge is placed on storefront forms.
field.modal: Selects the on-screen position of the reCAPTCHA v2 Invisible badge shown on protected storefront forms. Can be set per website.

field.comment: The Google reCAPTCHA v2 Invisible secret key used to verify storefront responses.
field.modal: The private (secret) key issued by Google for reCAPTCHA v2 Invisible, used server-side to verify responses from protected storefront forms. Stored encrypted and can be set per website.

field.comment: The Google reCAPTCHA v2 Invisible site key used on storefront forms.
field.modal: The public (website) key issued by Google for reCAPTCHA v2 Invisible, used to render the widget on protected storefront forms. Stored encrypted and can be set per website.

field.comment: The colour theme of the reCAPTCHA badge on storefront forms.
field.modal: Selects the colour theme used for the reCAPTCHA v2 Invisible badge on protected storefront forms. Can be set per website.

field.comment: Google reCAPTCHA v2 secret key used to verify storefront reCAPTCHA responses server-side.
field.modal: The secret key issued by Google for reCAPTCHA v2, used server-side to validate checkbox responses on the **storefront**. Stored encrypted; keep it confidential. Can differ per website.

field.comment: Google reCAPTCHA v2 site key for the storefront's "I am not a robot" widget.
field.modal: The public site key issued by Google for reCAPTCHA v2 ("I am not a robot"), used to render the checkbox widget on **storefront** forms. Stored encrypted. Can differ per website.

field.comment: The display size of the storefront reCAPTCHA v2 checkbox widget.
field.modal: Sets the size of the reCAPTCHA v2 checkbox widget shown on the storefront, to suit the form layout. Can differ per website.

field.comment: The colour theme of the storefront reCAPTCHA v2 checkbox widget.
field.modal: Sets the colour theme of the reCAPTCHA v2 checkbox widget on the storefront, to match the surrounding page. Can differ per website.

field.comment: Where the reCAPTCHA v3 Invisible badge appears on storefront forms.
field.modal: Sets the on-screen position of the invisible reCAPTCHA badge for storefront forms. Can be set per website.

field.comment: The Google reCAPTCHA v3 Invisible secret key used to validate storefront forms.
field.modal: The secret key from your Google reCAPTCHA v3 Invisible registration, used server-side to validate responses on storefront forms. Stored encrypted. Can be set per website.

field.comment: The Google reCAPTCHA v3 Invisible site key used for storefront forms.
field.modal: The public site key from your Google reCAPTCHA v3 Invisible registration, used to render reCAPTCHA on storefront forms. Stored encrypted. Can be set per website.

field.comment: The visual theme of the reCAPTCHA v3 Invisible badge on storefront forms.
field.modal: Selects the visual theme of the invisible reCAPTCHA badge shown on storefront forms. Can be set per website.

field.comment: The month and day the admin dashboard's Year-To-Date period begins.
field.modal: Sets the start month and day used for Year-To-Date totals shown on the admin dashboard.

field.comment: The file types customers may attach to an RMA request.
field.modal: The set of file extensions accepted for attachments on a return request; files of other types are rejected. Can differ per website.

field.comment: Which store email identity RMA notification emails are sent from.
field.modal: Selects the sender identity used for RMA (return) notification emails — one of the **Store Email Addresses** identities (General Contact, Sales Representative, Customer Support, Custom 1/2) configured under *General → Store Email Addresses*. Can be set per store view.

field.comment: Enables a per-category product RSS feed.
field.modal: When enabled, shoppers can subscribe to an RSS feed of products within a top-level category.

field.comment: Enables the RSS feed of coupons and discounts.
field.modal: When enabled, a public RSS feed of current coupons and discounts is published. (RSS feeds must also be enabled globally.) Can differ per website or store view.

field.comment: Enables the RSS feed of new products.
field.modal: When enabled, a public RSS feed of newly added products is published. (RSS feeds must also be enabled globally.)

field.comment: Enables the RSS feed of special-price (sale) products.
field.modal: When enabled, a public RSS feed of products on special price is published.

field.comment: Enables RSS feed generation across the storefront.
field.modal: Enables or disables RSS feeds site-wide. Individual feeds (catalog, wishlist, and others) require this master switch to be enabled. Can differ per website or store view.

field.comment: Whether the customer order status RSS feed is available.
field.modal: When Enabled, customers can subscribe to an RSS feed that reports their order status changes. Options are Enable and Disable. Can differ per store view.

field.comment: Enables an RSS feed for shared wish lists.
field.modal: When enabled, a shared wish list can be followed via RSS. Options are **Enable** and **Disable**. Can differ per store view.

field.comment: Whether rate limiting is applied to order placement requests.
field.modal: When Yes, the number of order-placement requests is capped per customer and per guest to protect the store from bursts of checkout traffic. Can differ per website or store view.

field.comment: Maximum order-placement requests allowed per guest in the period.
field.modal: The cap on how many order-placement requests a single guest may make within the configured reset period. Applies only when rate limiting is enabled. Can differ per website or store view.

field.comment: Maximum order-placement requests allowed per authenticated customer in the period.
field.modal: The cap on how many order-placement requests a single signed-in customer may make within the configured reset period. Applies only when rate limiting is enabled. Can differ per website or store view.

field.comment: The length of the time window after which the request counter resets.
field.modal: Selects the time period over which order-placement requests are counted before the per-customer and per-guest limits reset. Applies only when rate limiting is enabled. Can differ per website or store view.

field.comment: Whether customers can cancel their own orders through GraphQL.
field.modal: When **Yes**, customers can cancel eligible orders through the GraphQL API. Can be set per website or store view.

field.comment: The list of reasons a customer can choose from when cancelling an order.
field.modal: Defines the selectable reasons offered to customers when they cancel an order. Can be set per website or store view.

field.comment: How copies of the credit memo comment email are sent — as Bcc or as a separate email.
field.modal: Chooses whether copies of the credit memo comment email are sent as a **Bcc** on the customer's email or as a **Separate Email**. Applies only when the credit memo comment email is enabled. Can differ per store view.

field.comment: Whether an email is sent when a comment is added to a credit memo.
field.modal: When Yes, the customer is emailed when a comment is added to a credit memo. Can differ per store view.

field.comment: Which store email identity the credit memo comment email is sent from.
field.modal: Selects the sender for credit memo comment emails — one of the Store Email Addresses identities (General Contact, Sales Representative, Customer Support, Custom 1/2). Applies only when the credit memo comment email is enabled. Can differ per store view.

field.comment: How copies of the credit memo email are sent — as Bcc or as a separate email.
field.modal: Chooses whether copies of the credit memo email are sent as a **Bcc** on the customer's email or as a **Separate Email**. Applies only when the credit memo email is enabled. Can differ per store view.

field.comment: Whether the credit memo email is sent.
field.modal: When Yes, an email is sent to the customer when a credit memo is created for their order. Can differ per store view.

field.comment: Which store email identity the credit memo email is sent from.
field.modal: Selects the sender for credit memo emails — one of the Store Email Addresses identities (General Contact, Sales Representative, Customer Support, Custom 1/2). Applies only when the credit memo email is enabled. Can differ per store view.

field.comment: Whether sales emails are queued and sent in the background rather than immediately.
field.modal: When Enabled, sales emails are sent asynchronously through the message queue and cron instead of at the moment of the action. Options are Enable and Disable.

field.comment: How copies of the invoice comment email are sent — as Bcc or as a separate email.
field.modal: Chooses whether copies of the invoice comment email are sent as a **Bcc** on the customer's email or as a **Separate Email**. Applies only when the invoice comment email is enabled. Can differ per store view.

field.comment: Whether an email is sent when a comment is added to an invoice.
field.modal: When Yes, the customer is emailed when a comment is added to an invoice. Can differ per store view.

field.comment: Which store email identity the invoice comment email is sent from.
field.modal: Selects the sender for invoice comment emails — one of the Store Email Addresses identities (General Contact, Sales Representative, Customer Support, Custom 1/2). Applies only when the invoice comment email is enabled. Can differ per store view.

field.comment: How copies of the invoice email are sent — as Bcc or as a separate email.
field.modal: Chooses whether copies of the invoice email are sent as a **Bcc** on the customer's email or as a **Separate Email**. Applies only when the invoice email is enabled. Can differ per store view.

field.comment: Whether the invoice email is sent.
field.modal: When Yes, an email is sent to the customer when an invoice is created for their order. Can differ per store view.

field.comment: Which store email identity the invoice email is sent from.
field.modal: Selects the sender for invoice emails — one of the Store Email Addresses identities (General Contact, Sales Representative, Customer Support, Custom 1/2). Applies only when the invoice email is enabled. Can differ per store view.

field.comment: How copies of the order comment email are sent — as Bcc or as a separate email.
field.modal: Chooses whether copies of the order comment email are sent as a **Bcc** on the customer's email or as a **Separate Email**. Applies only when the order comment email is enabled. Can differ per store view.

field.comment: Whether an email is sent when a comment is added to an order.
field.modal: When Yes, the customer is emailed when a comment is added to their order. Can differ per store view.

field.comment: Which store email identity the order comment email is sent from.
field.modal: Selects the sender for order comment emails — one of the Store Email Addresses identities (General Contact, Sales Representative, Customer Support, Custom 1/2). Applies only when the order comment email is enabled. Can differ per store view.

field.comment: How copies of the order confirmation email are sent — as Bcc or as a separate email.
field.modal: Chooses whether copies of the order confirmation are sent as a **Bcc** on the customer's email or as a **Separate Email**. Applies only when the order email is enabled. Can differ per store view.

field.comment: Whether the new order confirmation email is sent.
field.modal: When Yes, a confirmation email is sent to the customer when an order is placed. Can differ per store view.

field.comment: Which store email identity the new order confirmation is sent from.
field.modal: Selects the sender for order confirmation emails — one of the Store Email Addresses identities (General Contact, Sales Representative, Customer Support, Custom 1/2). Applies only when the order email is enabled. Can differ per store view.

field.comment: Whether copies of the "order ready for pickup" email are sent as Bcc or as a separate email.
field.modal: Chooses how copy recipients receive the Order Ready For Pickup email: **Bcc** (hidden on the customer's copy) or as a **Separate Email**. Can differ per store view.

field.comment: Whether the "order ready for pickup" notification email is sent to customers.
field.modal: Controls whether customers receive the **Order Ready For Pickup** email when their in-store pickup order is ready to collect. Can be set per website or store view.

field.comment: Which store email identity the "order ready for pickup" email is sent from.
field.modal: Selects the sender identity for the Order Ready For Pickup email — one of the **Store Email Addresses** identities (General Contact, Sales Representative, Customer Support, Custom 1/2). Can differ per store view.

field.comment: How copies of the shipment comment email are sent — as Bcc or as a separate email.
field.modal: Chooses whether copies of the shipment comment email are sent as a **Bcc** on the customer's email or as a **Separate Email**. Applies only when the shipment comment email is enabled. Can differ per store view.

field.comment: Whether an email is sent when a comment is added to a shipment.
field.modal: When Yes, the customer is emailed when a comment is added to a shipment. Can differ per store view.

field.comment: Which store email identity the shipment comment email is sent from.
field.modal: Selects the sender for shipment comment emails — one of the Store Email Addresses identities (General Contact, Sales Representative, Customer Support, Custom 1/2). Applies only when the shipment comment email is enabled. Can differ per store view.

field.comment: How copies of the shipment email are sent — as Bcc or as a separate email.
field.modal: Chooses whether copies of the shipment email are sent as a **Bcc** on the customer's email or as a **Separate Email**. Applies only when the shipment email is enabled. Can differ per store view.

field.comment: Whether the shipment email is sent.
field.modal: When Yes, an email is sent to the customer when a shipment is created for their order. Can differ per store view.

field.comment: Which store email identity the shipment email is sent from.
field.modal: Selects the sender for shipment emails — one of the Store Email Addresses identities (General Contact, Sales Representative, Customer Support, Custom 1/2). Applies only when the shipment email is enabled. Can differ per store view.

field.comment: Whether shoppers can add a gift message to individual order items.
field.modal: When **Yes**, customers can attach a separate gift message to each item in the order during checkout. Can differ per website.

field.comment: Whether shoppers can add a single gift message to the whole order.
field.modal: When **Yes**, customers can attach one gift message at the order level during checkout. Can differ per website.

field.comment: The store address printed on invoices and packing slips.
field.modal: The address block shown in the header of printed invoices and packing slips. Can differ per website or store view.

field.comment: The label shown on the Instant Purchase button.
field.modal: The text displayed on the Instant Purchase button that lets customers check out in one click. Applies only when **Instant Purchase** is enabled. Can be set per store view for localised wording.

field.comment: Whether a minimum order amount is required before checkout.
field.modal: When Yes, orders whose total is below the configured minimum amount cannot be placed. Can differ per website.

field.comment: The message shown in the cart when the order is below the minimum amount.
field.modal: The error text displayed in the shopping cart when the order total is below the minimum order amount. Can differ per store view.

field.comment: Whether each address must meet the minimum order amount in multi-address checkout.
field.modal: When Yes, the minimum order amount is validated for each shipping address separately during multi-address checkout, rather than against the order as a whole. Can differ per website.

field.comment: Whether the minimum order amount is compared with tax included.
field.modal: Chooses whether the order total is checked against the minimum amount including tax or excluding it. Can differ per website.

field.comment: When the actual price is revealed for products using a Minimum Advertised Price.
field.modal: Chooses where the real price is shown instead of the MAP: **On Gesture** (after a click/popup), **In Cart**, or **Before Order Confirmation**. Can differ per website.

field.comment: The default text shown in the MAP price popup.
field.modal: The message displayed in the popup that explains why the actual price is hidden for Minimum Advertised Price products. Can differ per website or store view.

field.comment: The default text shown in the MAP "What's This" popup.
field.modal: The message displayed in the "What's This" popup linked from Minimum Advertised Price products. Can differ per website or store view.

field.comment: How long, in minutes, a pending-payment order is kept before it is cancelled.
field.modal: The lifetime in minutes for orders awaiting payment; a scheduled job cancels orders older than this. Can differ per website.

field.comment: Whether the order ID is shown in the header of printed credit memos.
field.modal: When Yes, the order ID is printed in the header of the credit memo PDF. Can differ per store view.

field.comment: Whether the order ID is shown in the header of printed invoices.
field.modal: When Yes, the order ID is printed in the header of the invoice PDF. Can differ per store view.

field.comment: Whether the order ID is shown in the header of printed shipments.
field.modal: When Yes, the order ID is printed in the header of the shipment (packing slip) PDF. Can differ per store view.

field.comment: Whether customers can reorder a previous order from their account.
field.modal: When Yes, the Reorder action is available in the customer account and order history, letting shoppers place a new order based on a past one. Can differ per store view.

field.comment: The position of the Discount line among the cart and checkout totals, as a sort order number.
field.modal: A numeric sort order that sets where the Discount line appears in the totals block of the cart and checkout. Lower numbers appear higher. Can differ per website.

field.comment: The position of the Grand Total line among the cart and checkout totals, as a sort order number.
field.modal: A numeric sort order that sets where the Grand Total line appears in the totals block of the cart and checkout. Lower numbers appear higher. Can differ per website.

field.comment: The position of the Shipping line among the cart and checkout totals, as a sort order number.
field.modal: A numeric sort order that sets where the Shipping line appears in the totals block of the cart and checkout. Lower numbers appear higher. Can differ per website.

field.comment: The position of the Subtotal line among the cart and checkout totals, as a sort order number.
field.modal: A numeric sort order that sets where the Subtotal line appears in the totals block of the cart and checkout. Lower numbers appear higher. Can differ per website.

field.comment: The position of the Tax line among the cart and checkout totals, as a sort order number.
field.modal: A numeric sort order that sets where the Tax line appears in the totals block of the cart and checkout. Lower numbers appear higher. Can differ per website.

field.comment: The position of the Fixed Product Tax line among the order totals.
field.modal: A sort-order number that sets where the Fixed Product Tax line appears relative to the other totals (subtotal, shipping, tax, etc.). Can differ per website.

field.comment: Whether a credit memo with a zero grand total can be created.
field.modal: When Yes, a credit memo can be issued even when its grand total comes to zero. Can differ per store view.

field.comment: Whether guests, not only signed-in customers, can use Email to a Friend.
field.modal: When **Yes**, visitors who are not signed in can send the **Email to a Friend** product share. Applies only when the feature is enabled. Can be set per website or store view.

field.comment: How senders are identified when enforcing the Email to a Friend sending limits.
field.modal: Selects the method used to identify a sender when applying the sending limits. Applies only when the feature is enabled. Can be set per website or store view.

field.comment: The maximum number of products a sender can share by email within one hour.
field.modal: Rate limit for how many products a single sender may share via Email to a Friend within one hour. Applies only when the feature is enabled. Can be set per website or store view.

field.comment: The maximum number of recipients allowed per Email to a Friend message.
field.modal: The maximum number of recipient addresses allowed in a single Email to a Friend message. Applies only when the feature is enabled. Can be set per website or store view.

field.comment: The city the store ships from.
field.modal: The city of the store's shipping origin address. Can be set per website.

field.comment: The country the store ships from, used as the origin for shipping-rate calculation.
field.modal: The country of the store's shipping origin. Carriers use it as the starting point when calculating shipping rates and estimating delivery. Can be set per website.

field.comment: The ZIP or postal code the store ships from.
field.modal: The postal code of the store's shipping origin, used by carriers to calculate shipping rates. Can be set per website.

field.comment: The state or region the store ships from.
field.modal: The region or state of the store's shipping origin, paired with the origin country for rate calculation. Can be set per website.

field.comment: The street address the store ships from.
field.modal: The street address of the store's shipping origin. Can be set per website.

field.comment: The second line of the store's shipping origin street address.
field.modal: An optional second line for the shipping origin street address. Can be set per website.

field.comment: Whether a custom shipping policy is shown to customers at checkout.
field.modal: When **Yes**, the custom shipping policy text is displayed to customers during checkout. Set to **No** to hide it. Can be set per website.

field.comment: The custom shipping policy text shown to customers.
field.modal: The shipping policy wording displayed at checkout. Applies only when **Apply custom Shipping Policy** is set to Yes. Can differ per website or store view.

field.comment: The changefreq hint written for category URLs in the XML sitemap.
field.modal: How often category pages are declared to change, as the sitemap `<changefreq>` value: always, hourly, daily, weekly, monthly, yearly or never. A hint to crawlers, not a guarantee.

field.comment: Turns scheduled automatic sitemap generation on or off.
field.modal: When **Yes**, the sitemap is regenerated automatically on a schedule (see the Frequency and Start Time below). When **No**, it is only generated manually.

field.comment: Email address that receives a notice if scheduled sitemap generation fails.
field.modal: Where the failure notification is sent when a scheduled sitemap run errors. Applies only when scheduled generation is **Enabled**.

field.comment: Which store email identity the sitemap error notice is sent from.
field.modal: The sender identity for the generation-failure email, chosen from the **Store Email Addresses** identities. Applies only when scheduled generation is **Enabled**.

field.comment: How often the scheduled sitemap regeneration runs.
field.modal: The cadence of the automatic sitemap run. Applies only when scheduled generation is **Enabled**.

field.comment: Time of day the scheduled sitemap generation runs.
field.modal: The hour and minute at which the automatic sitemap run is scheduled. Applies only when scheduled generation is **Enabled**.

field.comment: Maximum number of URLs written to a single sitemap file before it is split.
field.modal: Caps how many URLs go into one sitemap file; once exceeded, Magento writes additional files and a sitemap index. Keep within the sitemaps.org limit of 50,000 URLs per file.

field.comment: The changefreq hint written for CMS page URLs in the XML sitemap.
field.modal: How often CMS pages are declared to change in the sitemap (`<changefreq>`): always, hourly, daily, weekly, monthly, yearly or never.

field.comment: The changefreq hint written for product URLs in the XML sitemap.
field.modal: How often product pages are declared to change in the sitemap (`<changefreq>`): always, hourly, daily, weekly, monthly, yearly or never.

field.comment: Whether product images are added to sitemap entries, and which ones.
field.modal: Controls product image inclusion in the sitemap: **None**, the **Base Only** image, or **All** gallery images.

field.comment: Whether the sitemap's location is added to robots.txt.
field.modal: When **Yes**, a `Sitemap:` line pointing at the generated file is written into robots.txt so crawlers can discover it.

field.comment: The changefreq hint written for the store/home URL in the XML sitemap.
field.modal: How often the store home URL is declared to change in the sitemap (`<changefreq>`): always, hourly, daily, weekly, monthly, yearly or never.

field.comment: How often the admin checks the notification feed for new messages.
field.modal: The interval at which Magento polls its notifications feed for new messages. Choose a longer interval to check less frequently.

field.comment: Whether the admin fetches the notification feed over HTTPS.
field.modal: When **Yes**, the Magento notifications feed is retrieved over a secure HTTPS connection rather than plain HTTP.

field.comment: How many days bulk (asynchronous) operation log entries are kept before being purged.
field.modal: The retention period, in days, for bulk action log records; older entries are removed after this many days.

field.comment: How often, in minutes, completed cron history for this group is cleaned up.
field.modal: The interval, in minutes, between clean-ups of old schedule history records for this cron group.

field.comment: How long, in minutes, failed job records are kept before cleanup.
field.modal: How many minutes records of failed jobs are retained in the schedule table before being removed, for this cron group.

field.comment: How long, in minutes, successful job records are kept before cleanup.
field.modal: How many minutes records of successfully completed jobs are retained in the schedule table before being removed, for this cron group.

field.comment: How far ahead, in minutes, cron jobs are pre-generated for this group.
field.modal: How many minutes into the future schedule rows are created, so jobs for this cron group are queued before their run time.

field.comment: How often, in minutes, upcoming cron schedule rows are pre-generated for this group.
field.modal: The interval, in minutes, at which pending jobs for this cron group are written ahead into the schedule table.

field.comment: The window, in minutes, after which an un-run scheduled job is marked missed.
field.modal: If a scheduled job for this group has not started within this many minutes of its due time, it is marked as missed rather than run.

field.comment: Whether this cron group's jobs run in a separate PHP process.
field.modal: When **Yes**, jobs in this cron group are executed in their own PHP process, isolating them from other groups.

field.comment: The full set of currencies available for use as allowed or display currencies.
field.modal: The currencies installed for the store, forming the pool from which **Allowed Currencies** and the **Default Display Currency** are chosen.

field.comment: Selects which application handles full page caching.
field.modal: Chooses the full page caching backend — the built-in Magento cache or an external caching application such as Varnish. The Varnish Configuration options apply when Varnish is selected.

field.comment: Downloads a Varnish 6 configuration (VCL) file based on the current cache settings.
field.modal: Generates and downloads a Varnish 6 VCL configuration file from the current cache settings. Shown in the Varnish Configuration group when Varnish is selected as the caching application.

field.comment: Downloads a Varnish 7 configuration (VCL) file based on the current cache settings.
field.modal: Generates and downloads a Varnish 7 VCL configuration file from the current cache settings. Shown in the Varnish Configuration group when Varnish is selected as the caching application.

field.comment: Whether the legacy (old) media gallery is used instead of the enhanced one.
field.modal: When **Yes**, the old media gallery interface is used for managing images and media; when **No**, the enhanced media gallery is used.

field.comment: Turns on generation of optimized, resized renditions of media gallery images.
field.modal: When **Yes**, Magento generates optimized renditions (smaller resized copies) of media gallery images. Set to **No** to turn rendition generation off.

field.comment: Which configured database connection media files are stored in.
field.modal: Picks the database resource (from the connections defined in the deployment config) used to hold media files. Applies only when **Media Storage** is set to Database.

field.comment: Where product and catalog media files are stored — the file system or the database.
field.modal: Selects the backend for media files: **File System** (the default) or **Database (Deprecated)**. Choose Database only for legacy multi-server setups that relied on it; File System is recommended for new stores.

field.comment: How long failed messages are kept before cleanup removes them.
field.modal: The retention period for messages that failed processing, after which the queue cleanup removes them.

field.comment: How long new, unprocessed messages are kept before cleanup removes them.
field.modal: The retention period for new messages that have not yet been processed, after which the queue cleanup removes them.

field.comment: How long a message may stay in progress before it is retried.
field.modal: The waiting period after which a message still marked as in progress is released and retried, so stalled messages are not lost.

field.comment: How long successfully processed messages are kept before cleanup removes them.
field.modal: The retention period for messages that have been processed successfully, after which the queue cleanup removes them.

field.comment: The authentication method used to connect to the SMTP server.
field.modal: The SMTP authentication method: **NONE**, **PLAIN**, or **LOGIN**. Applies only when Transport is set to SMTP. Can differ per website or store view.

field.comment: Stops the store from sending any outbound email.
field.modal: When **Yes**, all outbound email from the store is suppressed. Useful on staging/testing environments to avoid emailing real customers. Can differ per website or store view.

field.comment: The Return-Path (bounce) address used for outbound email.
field.modal: The address that receives bounce notifications for outbound mail. Applies only when **Set Return-Path** is set to Specified. Must be a valid email. Can differ per website or store view.

field.comment: Whether to set the email Return-Path header, and whether to use a specified address.
field.modal: Controls the Return-Path (bounce) address on outbound mail: **No**, **Yes** (use the sender address), or **Specified** (use the Return-Path Email below). Can differ per website or store view.

field.comment: The encryption used when connecting to the SMTP server.
field.modal: The connection security for SMTP: **None**, **SSL**, or **TLS**. Applies only when Transport is set to SMTP. Can differ per website or store view.

field.comment: How outbound mail is sent — via Sendmail or an SMTP server.
field.modal: Selects the mail transport: **Sendmail** (the local MTA) or **SMTP** (an external mail server). Choosing SMTP enables the related Auth and SSL settings. Can differ per website or store view.

field.comment: Whether to enable animated View Transitions in the Admin panel.
field.modal: When **Yes**, the browser View Transitions API is used to animate navigation within the Admin panel. Set to **No** to disable the effect.

field.comment: How tax is rounded — per unit, per row, or on the total.
field.modal: The rounding method for tax: **Unit Price** (round each item), **Row Total** (round each line), or **Total** (round the order total). Affects cent-level differences on multi-item orders.

field.comment: Whether tax is applied before or after discounts.
field.modal: Chooses whether customer tax is calculated on the price **Before Discount** or **After Discount** — this changes the taxable base when promotions apply.

field.comment: Whether tax uses the custom price or the original price.
field.modal: Applies tax on the **Custom price if available**, or always on the **Original price**, for items with a special/custom price.

field.comment: Which address tax is calculated from.
field.modal: Whether tax is based on the **Shipping Address**, the **Billing Address**, or the store's **Shipping Origin**.

field.comment: Whether the cart breaks tax down by rate instead of a single line.
field.modal: When **Yes**, the cart shows a full tax summary (each tax rate itemised) rather than one combined tax line.

field.comment: Whether the cart also shows the order total without tax.
field.modal: When **Yes**, the cart additionally shows the grand total excluding tax alongside the taxed total.

field.comment: Whether cart item prices show including tax, excluding tax, or both.
field.modal: Price display for items in the shopping cart: **Excluding Tax**, **Including Tax**, or **Including and Excluding Tax**.

field.comment: Whether the cart shipping amount shows including tax, excluding tax, or both.
field.modal: Shipping-amount display in the cart: **Excluding Tax**, **Including Tax**, or **Including and Excluding Tax**.

field.comment: Whether the cart subtotal shows including tax, excluding tax, or both.
field.modal: Subtotal display in the cart: **Excluding Tax**, **Including Tax**, or **Including and Excluding Tax**.

field.comment: Whether a zero-value tax line is shown in the cart.
field.modal: When **Yes**, a tax line is shown even when the tax amount is zero; when **No**, it is hidden.

field.comment: The tax class assigned to a customer group when none is set.
field.modal: The default customer tax class, used together with the product tax class to resolve the applicable tax rate.

field.comment: The tax class assigned to a new product when none is set.
field.modal: The default product tax class used for products that don't specify one, determining which tax rates apply to them.

field.comment: The tax class applied to shipping charges.
field.modal: Which product tax class shipping is taxed under. Pick the class whose rates should apply to the shipping amount (or a 'None' class to leave shipping untaxed).

field.comment: Default country used to estimate tax before a customer address is known.
field.modal: The fallback destination country for tax estimation (e.g. catalog prices) until the customer provides an address.

field.comment: Default post code used to estimate tax before a customer address is known.
field.modal: The fallback destination post code for tax estimation. Use `*` to match any post code within the default region.

field.comment: Default state/region used to estimate tax before a customer address is known.
field.modal: The fallback destination state/region for tax estimation, paired with the Default Country.

field.comment: Whether shipping prices show including tax, excluding tax, or both.
field.modal: How shipping amounts are displayed in the catalog/estimates: **Excluding Tax**, **Including Tax**, or **Including and Excluding Tax**.

field.comment: Whether catalog prices show including tax, excluding tax, or both.
field.modal: How product prices appear in the catalog: **Excluding Tax**, **Including Tax**, or **Including and Excluding Tax**.

field.comment: Whether sales documents break tax down by rate instead of a single line.
field.modal: When **Yes**, sales documents show a full tax summary (each rate itemised) rather than one combined tax line.

field.comment: Whether sales documents also show the order total without tax.
field.modal: When **Yes**, orders, invoices and credit memos additionally show the grand total excluding tax.

field.comment: Whether prices on orders, invoices and credit memos show including tax, excluding tax, or both.
field.modal: Price display on sales documents (orders, invoices, credit memos): **Excluding Tax**, **Including Tax**, or **Including and Excluding Tax**.

field.comment: Whether the shipping amount on sales documents shows including tax, excluding tax, or both.
field.modal: Shipping-amount display on orders, invoices and credit memos: **Excluding Tax**, **Including Tax**, or **Including and Excluding Tax**.

field.comment: Whether the subtotal on sales documents shows including tax, excluding tax, or both.
field.modal: Subtotal display on orders, invoices and credit memos: **Excluding Tax**, **Including Tax**, or **Including and Excluding Tax**.

field.comment: Whether a zero-value tax line is shown on sales documents.
field.modal: When **Yes**, a tax line is shown on orders, invoices and credit memos even when the tax amount is zero.

field.comment: Whether tax is also applied on top of the Fixed Product Tax amount.
field.modal: When **Yes**, regular tax is calculated on the FPT amount as well as on the product price. Applies only when **Enable FPT** is Yes. Can differ per website.

field.comment: How Fixed Product Tax amounts are shown on the product view page.
field.modal: Controls the way FPT amounts are displayed on the product detail page. Applies only when **Enable FPT** is Yes. Can differ per website.

field.comment: How Fixed Product Tax amounts are shown in emails.
field.modal: Controls the way FPT amounts are displayed in transactional emails. Applies only when **Enable FPT** is Yes. Can differ per website.

field.comment: How Fixed Product Tax amounts are shown in product lists.
field.modal: Controls the way FPT amounts appear in category and other product lists (for example shown separately or rolled into the price). Applies only when **Enable FPT** is Yes. Can differ per website.

field.comment: How Fixed Product Tax amounts are shown in sales documents.
field.modal: Controls the way FPT amounts are displayed in sales areas such as the cart, orders and invoices. Applies only when **Enable FPT** is Yes. Can differ per website.

field.comment: Turns Fixed Product Tax (FPT) calculation on or off.
field.modal: When set to **Yes**, Fixed Product Tax (FPT) is calculated and applied to products that carry an FPT attribute. Can be set per website, so FPT can be active on one website and off on another.

field.comment: Whether the Fixed Product Tax is included in the order subtotal.
field.modal: When **Yes**, FPT is added into the order subtotal rather than shown as a separate amount. Applies only when **Enable FPT** is Yes. Can differ per website.

field.comment: The CardinalCommerce API Identifier used to authenticate 3-D Secure requests.
field.modal: The API Identifier credential issued by CardinalCommerce. Stored encrypted. Applies only when the integration is enabled. Can differ per website.

field.comment: The CardinalCommerce API key used to authenticate 3-D Secure requests.
field.modal: The API key credential issued by CardinalCommerce. Stored encrypted. Applies only when the integration is enabled. Can differ per website.

field.comment: Whether CardinalCommerce request and response details are written to the debug log.
field.modal: When **Yes**, CardinalCommerce communication is logged for troubleshooting. Applies only when the integration is enabled. Can differ per website.

field.comment: Whether CardinalCommerce 3-D Secure requests use the sandbox or production environment.
field.modal: Selects the CardinalCommerce target: **Sandbox** for testing or **Production** for live transactions. Applies only when the CardinalCommerce integration is enabled. Can differ per website.

field.comment: The CardinalCommerce Org Unit ID used to authenticate 3-D Secure requests.
field.modal: The Org Unit ID credential issued by CardinalCommerce for the Cardinal Cruise API. Stored encrypted. Applies only when the integration is enabled. Can differ per website.

field.comment: The 'From' email address for the Custom Email 1 store identity.
field.modal: The sender email address used when the **Custom Email 1** identity is selected as the sender of a transactional email. Must be a valid email. Can differ per website or store view.

field.comment: The 'From' display name for the Custom Email 1 store identity.
field.modal: The sender name shown on emails sent from the **Custom Email 1** identity. Can differ per website or store view.

field.comment: The 'From' email address for the Custom Email 2 store identity.
field.modal: The sender email address used when the **Custom Email 2** identity is selected as the sender of a transactional email. Must be a valid email. Can differ per website or store view.

field.comment: The 'From' display name for the Custom Email 2 store identity.
field.modal: The sender name shown on emails sent from the **Custom Email 2** identity. Can differ per website or store view.

field.comment: The 'From' email address for the General Contact store identity.
field.modal: The sender email address for the **General Contact** identity, the default sender for many store notifications. Must be a valid email. Can differ per website or store view.

field.comment: The 'From' display name for the General Contact store identity.
field.modal: The sender name shown on emails sent from the **General Contact** identity. Can differ per website or store view.

field.comment: The 'From' email address for the Sales Representative store identity.
field.modal: The sender email address for the **Sales Representative** identity, used as the sender of sales-related emails. Must be a valid email. Can differ per website or store view.

field.comment: The 'From' display name for the Sales Representative store identity.
field.modal: The sender name shown on emails sent from the **Sales Representative** identity. Can differ per website or store view.

field.comment: The 'From' email address for the Customer Support store identity.
field.modal: The sender email address for the **Customer Support** identity, used as the sender of support-related emails. Must be a valid email. Can differ per website or store view.

field.comment: The 'From' display name for the Customer Support store identity.
field.modal: The sender name shown on emails sent from the **Customer Support** identity. Can differ per website or store view.

field.comment: The API key of your Authy account, used for Authy two-factor authentication; stored encrypted.
field.modal: The Authy API key that this store uses to send and verify Authy two-factor challenges. It is stored encrypted. Obtain it from your Authy/Twilio account.

field.comment: The approval message shown to users in Authy OneTouch push requests.
field.modal: The text displayed in the Authy OneTouch approval prompt that users receive when signing in. Use it to identify the request.

field.comment: The API hostname of your Duo Security account.
field.modal: The Duo API hostname (for example the `api-….duosecurity.com` host from your Duo admin panel) that this store contacts for the Duo Universal Prompt.

field.comment: The Client ID of your Duo Security application, used for the Duo Universal Prompt.
field.modal: Identifies the Duo Security application that authenticates admin sign-ins via the Duo Universal Prompt. Obtain it from your Duo admin panel and enter it here.

field.comment: The Client Secret of your Duo Security application; stored encrypted.
field.modal: The secret paired with the Duo **Client Id** for the Duo Universal Prompt. It is stored encrypted. Obtain it from your Duo admin panel.

field.comment: The integration key of your Duo Security application.
field.modal: The integration key issued for the Duo application used by the Duo Universal Prompt. Obtain it from your Duo admin panel.

field.comment: The secret key of your Duo Security application; stored encrypted.
field.modal: The secret key paired with the Duo **Integration Key**. It is stored encrypted. Obtain it from your Duo admin panel.

field.comment: Whether dynamically-defined attributes are exposed as fields on their entity types in the GraphQL schema.
field.modal: When **Yes**, dynamic (store-defined) attributes appear as typed fields on their entity in the GraphQL schema rather than only through generic containers. Can be set per website or store view.

field.comment: Whether visitors with cookies disabled are redirected to the No Cookies CMS page.
field.modal: When **Yes**, visitors whose browsers have cookies disabled are redirected to the configured CMS No Cookies page. Can be set per website or store view.

field.comment: Whether a notice is shown to visitors who have JavaScript disabled.
field.modal: When **Yes**, a notice is displayed to visitors whose browsers have JavaScript disabled. Can be set per website or store view.

field.comment: Whether a notice is shown to visitors who have local storage disabled.
field.modal: When **Yes**, a notice is displayed to visitors whose browsers have local storage disabled. Can be set per website or store view.

field.comment: The CMS page shown as the storefront home page.
field.modal: Selects which existing CMS page is used as the storefront home page. Can be set per website or store view.

field.comment: The CMS page shown when the visitor's browser has cookies disabled.
field.modal: Selects the CMS page displayed when a visitor's browser has cookies disabled. Can be set per website or store view.

field.comment: The CMS page shown when a requested page is not found (404).
field.modal: Selects the CMS page displayed when a URL does not match any route, i.e. a 404. Can be set per website or store view.

field.comment: The default storefront landing path used when no specific route is requested.
field.modal: The route the storefront falls back to for the home page when no path is given (typically `cms`). Can differ per website or store view.

field.comment: The default page layout for category pages.
field.modal: The layout applied to category pages that don't specify their own.

field.comment: The default page layout applied to CMS pages.
field.modal: The layout (for example 1 column or 2 columns) used by default for CMS pages that do not specify their own.

field.comment: The default page layout for product pages.
field.modal: The layout (e.g. 1 column, 2 columns left/right, 3 columns) applied to product pages that don't specify their own.

field.comment: The path served when a requested URL matches no route (the 404 page).
field.modal: The internal path rendered when a URL cannot be matched to any route, i.e. the 'page not found' target. Can differ per website or store view.

field.comment: Whether breadcrumb navigation is shown on CMS pages.
field.modal: When **Yes**, breadcrumb navigation is displayed on CMS pages. Can be set per website or store view.

field.comment: The HTTP header used to detect that SSL is terminated by a load balancer or proxy.
field.modal: The request header (e.g. `X-Forwarded-Proto`) that the store reads to recognise HTTPS when SSL is offloaded to a proxy or load balancer rather than handled by the web server directly.

field.comment: Removes index.php from storefront URLs using web server rewrites.
field.modal: When **Yes**, URLs are generated without `index.php`, relying on the web server's rewrite rules (e.g. Apache mod_rewrite or Nginx). Enable only when rewrites are configured on the server. Can differ per store view.

field.comment: Validates the browser's HTTP_USER_AGENT for the session, as anti-hijacking protection.
field.modal: When **Yes**, the session is tied to the request's HTTP_USER_AGENT and invalidated if it changes, guarding against session hijacking.

field.comment: Validates the HTTP_VIA header for the session, as anti-hijacking protection.
field.modal: When **Yes**, the session is tied to the request's HTTP_VIA header and invalidated if it changes. May cause issues behind some proxies.

field.comment: Validates the HTTP_X_FORWARDED_FOR header for the session, as anti-hijacking protection.
field.modal: When **Yes**, the session is tied to the request's HTTP_X_FORWARDED_FOR header and invalidated if it changes. May cause issues behind some proxies/load balancers.

field.comment: Validates that a session's client IP (REMOTE_ADDR) stays consistent, as anti-hijacking protection.
field.modal: When **Yes**, the session is bound to the client's REMOTE_ADDR and invalidated if it changes, guarding against session hijacking. May cause issues behind some proxies/NAT.

field.comment: Whether to disable PHP session handling for GraphQL requests.
field.modal: When **Yes**, GraphQL requests are served without starting a PHP session, which can improve performance for stateless API traffic.

field.comment: Whether to enforce a maximum number of field aliases in a GraphQL query.
field.modal: When **Yes**, GraphQL queries using more than the allowed number of aliases are rejected, limiting a known request-amplification technique. Can be set per website or store view.

field.comment: Whether to enforce configured limits on GraphQL query input size.
field.modal: When **Yes**, the configured GraphQL input limits are enforced, rejecting queries that exceed them. A safeguard against overly large or abusive queries. Can be set per website or store view.

field.comment: Whether to enforce a maximum character length for GraphQL queries.
field.modal: When **Yes**, GraphQL queries longer than the allowed character count are rejected. Can be set per website or store view.

field.comment: Whether Web API requests enforce limits on the size of input arrays and collections.
field.modal: When **Yes**, the Web API enforces input limits, such as the maximum number of items accepted in a request, rejecting oversized payloads to protect the store. Configured under **Magento Web API → Web Api Input Limits**.

field.comment: Which store email identity wish list sharing emails are sent from.
field.modal: Selects the sender identity used when a customer shares a wish list by email — one of the **Store Email Addresses** identities (General Contact, Sales Representative, Customer Support, Custom 1/2). Can differ per store view.

field.comment: Turns the storefront wish list feature on or off.
field.modal: When **Yes**, customers can add products to a wish list; **No** disables the feature. Can be set per website or store view.

field.comment: Whether the wish list block appears in the storefront sidebar.
field.modal: When **Yes**, a wish list block is shown in the storefront sidebar. Applies only when **Enabled** (wish list) is set to Yes. Can differ per store view.

field.comment: What the My Wish List link summary displays for its contents.
field.modal: Controls how the **My Wish List** link summarises the list's contents (such as item count versus quantity). Can differ per website.
